osaka_kitashinchi_shime.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, fried oysters, menchi katsu, soba and clam ramen to finish; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_kitashinchi_shime.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the soba and ramen are served in dashi or clam broth.
osaka_kitashinchi_shime.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat 17:00–23:00, reservation only; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private rooms in principle for four or more (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables, a private room of 6; heated tobacco in a designated area, cigarettes outside; e-cigarettes allowed in private rooms (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 1 July 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_shime.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, seafood and a noodle to finish] A calm fifth-floor izakaya in the Kitashinchi Building, a few steps from an underground-mall exit, named for the shime, the noodle that ends a night: soba or a rich clam ramen. Before that come generous sashimi platters served one per person (Nagasaki sea snail, Kagoshima tuna and amberjack, a seared Kagawa scallop), big Goto Islands oysters, firefly squid, homemade tofu and dashimaki, at prices diners call fair for Kitashinchi (2025–26). There is also a kue hotpot course with fish from the Goto Islands. Private rooms suit business dinners, and e-cigarettes are allowed there. Open until 1:00 on weekdays; Saturday by booking only.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: seasonal seafood and selected sake, finishing with soba or ramen, "the chef's special dishes"; courses include Nagasaki kue hotpot with fish from the Goto Islands "delivered directly from our sister restaurant in Fukuoka"; opened 1 July 2023. A July 2026 diner mentions the shop's duck mascot.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; clam ramen or soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: "The assorted sashimi platter (JPY 1,800, tax included) was served individually, making it easy to eat, which was a thoughtful touch." — July 2026.
"Although Kitashinchi has a reputation for being upscale, I was pleasantly surprised by how affordable this place was." — December 2025.
"The soba served at the end was also very tasty, further enhancing my satisfaction with the meal." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 〆。、居酒屋・海鮮・ラーメン、大阪市北区曾根崎新地1-3-19 北新地ビルディング 5F-E、JR 北新地駅から徒歩5分、西梅田駅から3分、月〜金17:00〜翌1:00、土17:00〜23:00 (予約のみ)、日・祝休み、予約可、個室は原則4名から、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル8、個室6)、加熱式たばこは喫煙スペース、紙たばこは外、2023年7月1日オープン、旬の魚介と日本酒、締めのそばかラーメン、アサリの濃厚なラーメン、全国の日本酒・ワイン・果実酒、6品のコース8,000円、馬刺しつき7品10,000円、Nagasaki のクエ鍋コース13,000円 (Fukuoka の姉妹店から Goto のクエ)、120分飲み放題は2,000円追加。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年9月): 刺身の盛り合わせ1人前1,800円 (Nagasaki のつぶ貝、Kagoshima のマグロとカンパチ、Miyagi のサーモン、Kagawa のホタテ)、Goto の生ガキ900円、ホタルイカの醤油漬け700円、アサリの酒蒸し1,200円、干した手羽600円、Hiroshima のカキフライ300円、桜のメンチかつ600円、もち豆腐400円、ポテトサラダ800円、鴨のたたき1,200円、だし巻き800円、もりそば1,200円、自家製豆腐、うざく、サバのみそ煮、個室では電子たばこ可、アヒルのマスコット、北新地にしては手頃。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter, tables and private rooms; Saturday by reservation (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

osaka_chabudai_bar_8_oyodo.gf_detail: Ask when booking; the shop asks for allergies with course bookings (Tabelog). No gluten information. Tacos come in tortillas, and the jerk chicken and other dishes use house spice blends whose ingredients are not listed.
osaka_chabudai_bar_8_oyodo.vegan_detail: Shop statement (Tabelog): "Vegetarian and vegan options are available as well"; Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. Reviews describe vegetable-rich lunch plates and roasted vegetables with balsamic sauce (2025), but most named dishes (taco rice with ground beef, jerk chicken, garlic shrimp) are meat or seafood, so ask which dishes can be made vegan.
osaka_chabudai_bar_8_oyodo.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:45–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday and Monday, but groups can book on closed days by phone (Tabelog). Lunch was taco rice only on a June 2026 visit. Dinner cover (otoshi) ¥350 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 35 seats at low chabudai tables, shoes off, plus a half-floor nook; private hire 20–50; non-smoking; English menu and digital menu; children welcome; takeout, bento and hors-d'oeuvre catering (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 12 May 2008 (Tabelog).
osaka_chabudai_bar_8_oyodo.notes: [World dishes · by Umeda Sky Building, low tables in an old house] A renovated old house on a back street two minutes from the Umeda Sky Building, where you take off your shoes and sit at low chabudai tables (there is also a half-floor nook). The kitchen cooks across cuisines with its own spice blends; diners keep coming back for the jerk chicken and the taco rice, which is the whole lunch menu some days, in three sizes with a Gorgonzola sauce on the side. Dinner is all-you-can-drink courses from about ¥4,400 for groups and office parties. The shop says it has vegetarian and vegan options. Diners describe a friendly owner and a cosy, slightly cramped room; one found the spicy seasoning repetitive, and the low tables are hard on the legs over a long evening. Closed Sundays and Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a cozy 35-seat restaurant in a renovated traditional house two minutes from Umeda Sky Building; fresh ingredients from the market each day, house-made spices, creative dishes across genres; lunch and dinner, plus bento and hors-d'oeuvre catering; vegetarian and vegan options. Opened 12 May 2008.
chef_bio.philosophy: Deliciousness across genres, from the day's market (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Taco rice; jerk chicken.

anecdotes.text: "As always, I enjoyed pleasant conversations with the friendly owner and had a great time with the delicious dishes." — May 2026, a workplace gathering.
"For lunch, they only offered Taco Rice at 8*. I ordered it with all the toppings, but unfortunately, they were out of avocado." — June 2026.
"The chabudai, which the restaurant is named after, creates a nice ambiance, but sitting for a long time can be uncomfortable for your legs." — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and digital menu (Tabelog); some overseas visitors (May 2025). Shoes off, low tables.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Tabelog course notes: "If you have any allergies, dislikes, or specific dish requests, please let us know when making your reservation."

positives.text: Shop statement (Tabelog): "Vegetarian and vegan options are available as well"; Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

osaka_teppanyaki_hanaui_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Courses include foie gras with bread, a sukiyaki-style course (sukiyaki sauce is usually soy-based with wheat), garlic rice and sauces; a diner who skipped foie gras was given another dish (July 2026).
osaka_teppanyaki_hanaui_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppan courses of wagyu, abalone, foie gras and seafood.
osaka_teppanyaki_hanaui_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–22:00 per Tabelog; on weekends and holidays dinner runs in two seatings at 18:00 and 20:30 (Tabelog), and a March 2026 diner describes the same two seatings for dinner generally. Reservation only; special prices for bookings through the shop's Instagram (Tabelog). Closed the third Sunday of each month and 2–3 other days a month (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; private hire by phone; non-smoking; bring-your-own drinks (Tabelog).
osaka_teppanyaki_hanaui_kitashinchi.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitashinchi, seven seats around one griddle] A seven-seat basement teppan counter in Kitashinchi, run by owner-chef Ryuichi Yasekawa (Tabelog), that diners call remarkable value for the area. Courses at ¥11,500 run from sashimi or a seasonal soup through foie gras on dashi-soaked daikon to live abalone in a truffle-scented liver sauce, which the chef turns into a small risotto with rice, then wagyu fillet and a sukiyaki-style ribeye with an onsen egg and garlic rice. A November 2025 diner found the owner-chef working alone and very friendly; another regular comes four or five times a year. Dishes can be swapped (one diner skipped foie gras), and the anniversary cake is ¥1,500 more. Reservation only; bring your own wine if you like.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): high-quality teppanyaki at a counter only; ingredients from trusted suppliers, the pride being A5 wagyu fillet and live domestic black abalone, finished with a rich abalone-liver sauce; an open kitchen; local sake and wine. Reviews: on a November 2025 visit "the owner-chef was running the place" alone and was very friendly; "The chef's kindness truly enhances the deliciousness of the dishes" (July 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients delicious to look at and to eat (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Live abalone with liver sauce; foie gras on daikon; wagyu fillet.

anecdotes.text: "The liver sauce was simply outstanding, and the addition of truffle aroma made it elegant without being too heavy. I also appreciated the touch of adding a bit of rice at the end" — March 2026, a birthday course.
"The highlight of the day was the foie gras with radish." — November 2025.
"I visit this place about 4 to 5 times a year." — July 2026; the shop swapped the foie gras for another dish on request.

cultural_comfort.note: Set teppan courses at a seven-seat counter, booked ahead (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

osaka_le_comptoir_champagne_shokudo.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu centres on fresh pasta, baguette, quiche and tapas (2026 reviews).
osaka_le_comptoir_champagne_shokudo.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Dishes in reviews are mostly meat, cheese and seafood (tripe, Bolognese, Comté, squid-ink penne); a lotus-root quiche came with vegetables (August 2026).
osaka_le_comptoir_champagne_shokudo.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays, though it may open on some holidays (check the website) (Tabelog). Happy hour on champagne from opening until 18:59 (Tabelog). Lunch: Tabelog lists dinner only, but reviewers ate pasta lunches and a booked wagyu lunch course in January and February 2026. Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 18 seats: 10 at the counter, two tables for 4, semi-private seating; non-smoking all day (Tabelog).
osaka_le_comptoir_champagne_shokudo.notes: [French · Kitashinchi, champagne and tapas at a counter] A ten-seat counter (plus two tables) from the Champagne Shokudo group, for French tapas, fresh pasta and a long list of champagne by the glass, cheapest in the happy hour before 19:00. Regulars order trippa in tomato, a lotus-root quiche or squid-ink penne alongside a glass of Pommery or the changing house champagne; a new chef arrived in summer 2026 and added dishes, which one regular called more refined (August 2026). Lunch was served early in 2026 (pasta lunches at about ¥1,000–3,000), though the listing gives dinner hours only. Expect ¥5,000–10,000 at dinner, plus 10% service. Non-smoking.

roles: Chef (unnamed; new by August 2026, per a review)
chef_bio.origin: Part of the シャンパン食堂 group: シャンパン食堂 北新地本店, this shop, and Stand Champagne Shoku in Kitashinchi, Akasaka Mitsuke and Ebisu (Tabelog remarks).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): French tapas, pasta and main dishes with seasonal ingredients, and champagne and wine at the counter; "It's all about the season!" The listing notes it is not the champagne-and-gyoza bar of the same group.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal food with champagne (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Champagne by the glass; trippa; fresh pasta.

anecdotes.text: "Recently, the chef has changed, and the dishes have become even more refined, with many new menu items added!" — August 2026, a third visit.
"The lotus root on top of the quiche is nicely roasted, providing a great crunch and is incredibly tasty." — August 2026, with Pommery.
"The portion sizes were explained to us", and portions were adjusted for the group — October 2026, four people à la carte.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter ordering of tapas and wine by the glass (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_yasaka_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking; the shop asks for allergies in advance (Tabelog). No gluten information. Courses include fried eel, tenderloin katsu and dashi-based dishes, and sashimi and sushi are usually served with soy sauce, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_yasaka_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish, shellfish, wagyu and dashi-based dishes.
osaka_yasaka_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before or after a holiday 18:00–1:00, closing time flexible; Saturdays on request; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Omakase courses; tell the shop about allergies and dislikes in advance; a private room for two may carry a room fee (Tabelog). Tabelog's translated note mentions a service charge, while its Japanese original reads なし (none). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at a single-slab counter and a private room for up to 6; smoking allowed, including e-cigarettes (Tabelog; April 2025); bring-your-own drinks; sommelier; takeout (Tabelog). Opened 28 June 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_yasaka_kitashinchi.notes: [Japanese · Kitashinchi main street, a small omakase counter] A small Japanese restaurant on Kitashinchi's main street with a six-seat counter cut from a single slab and a private room, serving an omakase of seven or eight dishes built on the season (salt-grilled tuna, Miyazaki beef, shark fin and shrimp chawanmushi, a seasonal rice pot) with wine chosen by a sommelier. The course is ¥14,300, or ¥16,500 with a private room for two. Reviews describe one chef cooking for the room, chatty and attentive, with a member of staff serving; it stays open late and allows smoking, e-cigarettes included. Few reviews but loyal ones: one guest is on a tenth visit (January 2026). Leftover rice comes home with you in a box.

roles: Chef (unnamed), cooking alone (December 2024 and April 2025 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): authentic Japanese cuisine by skilled artisans; an omakase course of carefully selected ingredients such as salt-grilled tuna and Miyazaki beef; wine pairings by a sommelier; private rooms and a single-slab counter. Opened 28 June 2021. Reviews: "Yasaka is a Japanese restaurant run by a single chef" (April 2025); "the chef was working solo during a busy time" (December 2024); "run by a tanned chef and a female staff member" (July 2025); "The chef is incredibly entertaining and a great conversationalist" (July 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Japanese cooking paired with wine (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase course; seasonal rice pot.

anecdotes.text: "The shirako chawanmushi (savory egg custard) and the oyster takikomi gohan (seasoned rice) were particularly outstanding." — February 2025, a seventh visit.
"The absolute highlight was the hotaru ika (firefly squid) rice as the closing dish." — April 2024.
"I even received some leftover rice as a takeaway." — April 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: One omakase course at a small counter or private room (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Tabelog course notes: "If you have any allergies or dislike certain ingredients, please let us know in advance."

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated January and April 2026.

osaka_steak_house_whisky_nova_namba.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Steaks and fish are charcoal-grilled and the sides include potatoes, mushrooms and salads, but courses come with focaccia or brioche and sauces are not described; nothing is called gluten-free.
osaka_steak_house_whisky_nova_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steakhouse; courses are built around dry-aged beef, pork or fish.
osaka_steak_house_whisky_nova_namba.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:30) (hotel site; Tabelog). Reservations online or by phone; same-day walk-ins found a table (September 2026). Service charge 15% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 58 seats (hotel site; 56 on Tabelog), private rooms for 4–8, a counter, window seats over the city; non-smoking; smart casual (hotel site; Tabelog). Birthday plates and cakes; a kids' plate (hotel site; September 2026). Corkage was ¥10,000 for wine (June 2026). On the 32nd floor of the hotel, linked to Namba Station (May 2026). Opened 1 July 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_steak_house_whisky_nova_namba.notes: [Steak · Namba, dry-aged beef on the 32nd floor] On the 32nd floor of Centara Grand Hotel Osaka, linked to Namba station, a calm steakhouse with big windows over the city. The beef is dry-aged two to four weeks in its own ageing room and seared in a charcoal oven at around 500°C (hotel site); T-bone, L-bone and sirloin are the signatures, cut with knives made for the restaurant by the Sakai knifesmith 實光. Lunch courses (about ¥7,700 in October 2026) bring salad, soup, a choice of fish or steak and sides that diners rate as highly as the meat, above all the sweet two-year-aged potato fries. The whisky list leans Japanese, with bottle keep. Diners in 2026 praise the view and the birthday touches; one found the steak ordinary for the price and the ¥10,000 corkage steep. 15% service. Open daily for lunch and dinner.

roles: Hotel restaurant team of Centara Grand Hotel Osaka (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the hotel site: a steakhouse of aged beef and produce from around Osaka, with premium wines, on the 32nd floor overlooking the city; beef dry-aged 2–4 weeks and cooked in a charcoal oven at about 500°C; steak knives specially made by 實光, a Sakai knife maker of more than 110 years, with a choice of persimmon, laurel, oak or cherry handles; a collection centred on Japanese whisky with a bottle-keep service. Opened 1 July 2023 (Tabelog). The Tabelog listing is shop-maintained; the service charge rose from 13% to 15% on 1 January 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Dry-aged T-bone and sirloin; two-year-aged potato fries.

anecdotes.text: "Two-year aged meikuin potato fries were sweet and delicious." — September 2026, a same-day birthday lunch.
"We chose both the strip loin and filet, and [the staff] kindly served them on separate plates." — March 2026, a weekend lunch.
"The corkage fee for wine was JPY 10,000!" — June 2026, a diner who found the steak inferior to other steak restaurants.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: センタラグランドホテル大阪 (公式サイト): ステーキハウス ノヴァ、熟成肉と大阪近郊の食材を味わうステーキハウス、熟成と火入れの技で仕上げたステーキ、厳選したプレミアムワイン、大阪の街を一望する32階、11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、17:30〜22:30 (L.O.21:30)、スマートカジュアル、58席、T-Bone、L-Bone、サーロイン、キャビアと自家製ブリオッシュ、鮮魚のグリル、炭火グリルシーザーサラダ、熟成ビーフバーガー、キッズプレート、ランチのサーロイン炭火焼き、毎月29日は特定のコースが29%OFF、ドライエイジング専用熟成庫で2〜4週間、約500度の炭オーブン、アニバーサリーケーキ、ジャパニーズウイスキーを中心にボトルキープ、ステーキナイフは創業百十余年の堺包丁の實光が特別に製作、ハンドルはシャム柿・月桂樹・オーク・チェリーから。食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキ・洋食・肉料理、浪速区難波中2-11-50 センタラグランドホテル大阪 32F、サービス料15% (2024年1月1日から)、56席、個室 (4〜8名)、禁煙、夜景、2023年7月1日オープン。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): 窓からの眺め、ランチのコース7,700円、2年熟成のじゃがいものフライ、Tボーン、誕生日のプレート、持ち込み料1万円、肉はふつうという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: A hotel restaurant; book online through the hotel site. No English menu evidence found.

osaka_tonkatsu_butashabu_hizono_shinmach.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tonkatsu and the other katsu are breaded and fried. The shabu-shabu is dipped in a house "soba dashi" made without buckwheat flour and in ponzu (official site), but both are soy-based and the course ends with green-tea soba; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_tonkatsu_butashabu_hizono_shinmach.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork restaurant (tonkatsu and pork shabu-shabu), with a pork miso soup.
osaka_tonkatsu_butashabu_hizono_shinmach.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 18:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sat dinner only; closed Sundays and public holidays, though open on some holidays as announced on Instagram (official site; Tabelog). Book on the official site, which takes priority over other booking sites; late arrivals keep the two-hour slot from the booked time (official site; Tabelog). At dinner one drink per person (soft drinks fine) and a ¥330 appetizer charge with alcohol; no appetizer at lunch (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) (Tabelog). 22 seats: an 8-seat counter, tables and a tatami room for 4–6 without a sunken floor; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway and delivery; English, Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog). One chef cooks, so food can take time (October 2026). Opened 3 April 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_tonkatsu_butashabu_hizono_shinmach.notes: [Tonkatsu · Shinmachi, TOKYO X and kurobuta by a pork-loving owner] A clean, calm counter-and-table room on a Shinmachi back street, opened in 2023 by an owner the site calls a pork lover, with a chef from Kagoshima. The pork is TOKYO X and Kagoshima kurobuta: crisp, light tonkatsu that one diner says is best with just salt, a TOKYO X top-loin katsudon as the signature, and at night shabu-shabu of the same pork in a clay pot with a house soba dashi and ponzu, finished with green-tea soba. The kitchen relaunched as "Shin Hizono" in summer 2026 with a new frying method and, from September, a ¥1,500 weekday lunch set. With one chef at the stove, food takes a little time; dinner is by course or à la carte with one drink each. Regulars come from as far as France (September 2026). Book on the official site; closed Sundays and holidays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; "豚好きな店主", a pork-loving owner, per the official site)
Chef from Kagoshima (official site: 当店の料理人は…鹿児島県の出身)
chef_bio.origin: Kagoshima (the chef, per the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: tonkatsu and shabu-shabu by a pork-loving owner, using the "phantom pork" TOKYO X and Kagoshima kurobuta; the signature is a TOKYO X top-loin katsudon; shabu-shabu dipped in an original soba dashi made without buckwheat flour; the chef comes from Kagoshima, the home of shochu, and picks shochu for taste, not fame. Opened 3 April 2023 (Tabelog). A September 2026 regular describes a "Shin Hizono" relaunch with a new frying technique that summer and a new lunch menu from September, and a night when, with a staff member ill, two people ran the room.
chef_bio.philosophy: Shochu chosen for being truly delicious regardless of fame (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: TOKYO X tonkatsu and katsudon; TOKYO X shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "Guests from Kanto, repeat visitors from France, and regulars gathered to enjoy tonkatsu and shabu-shabu" — September 2026, an 11th visit, the Shin Hizono banquet course.
"Tokyo X has an incredible sweetness, so I recommend enjoying it with salt. It feels like a waste to use sauce." — May 2026, lunch.
"Since the cooking is done by a single chef, it takes a little time to prepare." — October 2026, the ¥1,500 lunch loin set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tonkatsu-butashabu-hizono.com): とんかつ 豚しゃぶ 樋ぞの、四ツ橋駅3分、豚好きな店主が創るとんかつや豚しゃぶ、このサイトからのネット予約が最優先、幻の豚 TOKYO X や鹿児島黒豚、名物は TOKYO X を使用した上ロースかつ丼、TOKYO X のしゃぶしゃぶ鍋、銘柄豚それぞれの鍋コース、焼酎は「夢幻 (芋)」をはじめ、当店の料理人は焼酎の本場・鹿児島県の出身、しゃぶしゃぶはオリジナルのそば出汁 (そば粉不使用) とポン酢、柚子胡椒、締めの茶そば (雑炊に変更可能)、3種食べ比べのコース、西区新町1-22-19 桑名ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅2番出口徒歩3分、西大橋駅2番出口徒歩2分、心斎橋駅徒歩8分、月〜金 11:30-14:00・18:00-22:30、土 18:00-22:30、日曜・祝日休み (祝日はまれに営業)。食べログ (店舗会員): とんかつ・豚しゃぶ・かつ丼、22席 (カウンター8)、座敷の個室 (掘りごたつなし)、夜は1人1ドリンク、お酒を頼むと付き出し330円、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト・デリバリー、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2023年4月3日オープン。口コミ(2026年5月〜10月): TOKYO X は塩で、2026年夏に揚げ方を変えて「Shin Hizono」に、9月から新しいランチ (ロースかつ定食1,500円、ご飯おかわり無料)、TOKYO X しゃぶしゃぶコース4,950円、とんかつのコース、ごぼうたっぷりの豚汁、Kanto や France からの客、料理人ひとりなので少し時間がかかる。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog); book on the official site; regulars from abroad (September 2026).

existence.note: Official site and the shop-maintained Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_pane_e_vino_porcini_shinmachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery (focaccia, mochi bread, campagne, baguettes, buns, scones); the group says it uses domestic wheat where it can (official site).
osaka_pane_e_vino_porcini_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Ask. The salt focaccia (olive oil, salt) and plain hard breads may suit, but many breads use cream, butter, cheese, mentaiko or bacon; nothing is labelled vegan.
osaka_pane_e_vino_porcini_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–20:00; Sat 09:00–20:00; closed Sunday; a night bar on the last Saturday of each month, 19:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Takeaway only (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Bags cost ¥30–¥50 (October 2026). A small shop with little room to turn (June 2026); usually no queue, unlike the Fukushima shop (2026 reviews). Opened 10 May 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_pane_e_vino_porcini_shinmachi.notes: [Bakery · Shinmachi, the Fukushima favourite without the queue] A small bakery near Nishi-Ohashi that sells the breads of Pane Porcini, the popular Fukushima bakery whose group also runs an Italian taverna, bar, latteria and salumeria there. Diners come for the same signatures without the Fukushima line: a big, salty, olive-oil salt focaccia, chewy mochi bread, a soft custard cream bread, mentaiko campagne and a chewy baguette, mostly ¥220–¥300. On the last Saturday of the month it turns into a night bar (19:00–22:00). Reviews are mixed: most 2026 diners were happy, but a long-time Fukushima customer felt the quality had dropped after a change of staff (October 2026). Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Porcini group site (porcini.jp): the group's bakery Pane Porcini in Fukushima, a small back-street bakery open late, is known for salt focaccia, mochi bread and cream bread and uses domestic wheat where it can; the group also runs Taverna Porcini, Bar Porcini, a latteria and a salumeria in Fukushima. Diners describe this Shinmachi shop as Pane Porcini's sister store (2026). Opened 10 May 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Salt focaccia; mochi bread; cream bread.

anecdotes.text: "This is a sister restaurant of the extremely popular bakery 'Pane Porcini,' known for its long lines in the gourmet hotspot of Fukushima." — June 2026.
"The Mentaiko Campagne immediately caught my eye. The flavor of the whole wheat dough combined with the mentaiko paste creates a unique deliciousness!" — August 2026.
"Since the time the shop in Fukushima opened, I've bought around 200 items, but this might be the end for me." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ポルチーニ公式サイト (porcini.jp): 大阪福島、焼き立てパン「パネ・ポルチーニ」は塩フォカッチャ・もちパン・クリームパンが人気、できるだけ国産小麦にこだわり、夜遅くまで営業している路地裏の小さなパン屋 (福島区福島5-10-22)、イタリア食堂「タヴェルナ・ポルチーニ」、酒場「バール・ポルチーニ」、ラッテリア、サルメリア。食べログ: Pane E VINO Porcini 新町、パン、西区新町1-22-17、Nishi-Ohashi 駅2番出口から徒歩2分、月〜金 10:00〜20:00、土 9:00〜20:00、日曜休み、毎月最終土曜はナイトバー19:00〜22:00、持ち帰り、カード・PayPay可、禁煙、2023年5月10日オープン。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): 福島のパネ・ポルチーニの姉妹店、塩フォカッチャ269〜290円、もちパン269円、トリュフバターの塩パン231円、桃のブレッサン220円、明太カンパーニュ、クリームパン、福島より並ばずに買える、袋は30〜50円、店員が替わって質が落ちたという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service trays at a small counter shop (June 2026); bring your own bag.

osaka_grand_fleuve_minamihorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Most cakes sit on sponge, tart or mille-feuille pastry and the baked goods are financiers and similar; the Horie pudding and the mousses are not described either way.
osaka_grand_fleuve_minamihorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a French-style patisserie of cream, butter and egg cakes, puddings and baked goods.
osaka_grand_fleuve_minamihorie.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun 11:00–22:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Takeaway, with one table outside (February and August 2026). No cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Prices were raised in April 2026, per a notice seen in March 2026. Non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 4 January 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_grand_fleuve_minamihorie.notes: [Sweets · Minami-Horie, a neighbourhood patisserie since 2013] A small, stylish patisserie in the sweets-crowded streets of Horie, open since 2013 and praised by one local family as the best cake shop around. The case runs from a rich Mont Blanc on a tart base and a pistachio Mont Blanc to strawberry shortcake, Shine Muscat tart and raspberry mousse, with the TV-famous Horie pudding and a shelf of baked goods (moelleux chocolat and tigre at ¥410 in March 2026, before an April price rise). Diners call the cream light and not too sweet; one found a mille-feuille ordinary. Takeaway, with one table outside. Cash only. Closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; opened 4 January 2013. A March 2026 reviewer describes high-quality fresh and baked sweets based on classic French pastry, well regarded among Kansai patisserie fans. No owner or official site was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Mont Blanc; Horie pudding; baked goods.

anecdotes.text: "As for the Pistachio Mont Blanc, if you read this, you should rush to buy it. You must not leave this world without trying it." — November 2025.
"There was only one seat outside, so we enjoyed it in the freezing cold, but it was delicious!" — February 2026, a Mont Blanc.
"The pudding in Horie has gained fame from being featured on television." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): グランフルーヴ、ケーキ、西区南堀江1-16-3、Yotsubashi 駅から徒歩5分、Namba 駅26C出口から徒歩5分、月・木〜日 11:00〜22:30、火・水休み、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、2013年1月4日オープン。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年9月): タルト生地のモンブラン、ピスタチオのモンブラン、苺のショートケーキ、苺のチーズタルト、ラズベリーのムース、シャインマスカットのタルト、夏いちごのミルフィーユ、テレビで紹介されたHorie Pudding、モワルーショコラ410円、ティグレ410円、フィナンシェ302円 (2026年3月、4月から値上げの告知)、外に席がひとつ。

osaka_jinanbo_ramen_higashinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles; sets add fried rice or kara-age.
osaka_jinanbo_ramen_higashinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tonkotsu-based broths with minced meat and chashu.
osaka_jinanbo_ramen_higashinakajima.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–24:00; hours may change (Tabelog); a June 2026 diner says it is open until 1 am. No reservations; no cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). Counter seating and big tables, including an octagonal one (June 2026); smoking allowed (Tabelog). Reviews go back to 2007 on a ramen database, per a June 2026 diner.
osaka_jinanbo_ramen_higashinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Higashinakajima, tonkotsu in an iron pot] A long-running ramen shop on the main road south-east of Shin-Osaka Station, with reviews going back to 2007 (June 2026), open till midnight or later. The house "Jinanbo" ramen is a tonkotsu base with spicy miso and minced meat, brought bubbling in a cast-iron pot, "neither a true pork bone ramen nor a dan dan noodle" to one doubter (September 2026). There is also a mild tonkotsu, a creamy tantanmen, a tantan mazesoba with chewy wavy noodles, and shio and shoyu, usually ordered with fried rice made with minced meat; the half portion is close to a full one (May 2026). Portions are big; lunch fills it to 80% (May 2026). Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. A June 2026 diner notes reviews on a ramen database dating back to 2007, "so it seems this place has been in business for nearly 20 years"; staff explained that the minced meat in the Jinanbo is milder than in the dandan (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Jinanbo ramen in a cast-iron pot; tantan mazesoba.

anecdotes.text: "It's also unique that it's served in a cast iron pot instead of a regular bowl." — June 2026, the Jinanbo All Toppings for JPY 1,350.
"The half rice … was actually double what I imagined! It was practically a full portion of fried rice." — May 2026, with the tantan mazesoba.
"They are open until 1 AM, making it perfect for a late-night snack." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 次男坊ラーメン、ラーメン、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-12-30、JR 新大阪駅東口から徒歩10分、毎日11:00〜15:00、18:00〜24:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、カウンター、喫煙可。口コミ(2026年4月〜9月): とんこつ、担々、塩、醤油と看板の「次男坊」、次男坊は辛味噌とそぼろのとんこつで鉄鍋で出てくる、Jinanbo All Toppings 1,350円、大盛りはすり鉢のような器、マイルドなとんこつ、クリーミーな担々麺、担々まぜそば (中太のちぢれ麺)、そぼろのチャーハンのセット1,300円、kara-age のセット、天津飯のセット、大きなテーブル、2007年からの口コミがあるらしい、夜1時までという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: A wide ramen menu with sets; staff recommend sets. No English evidence found.

osaka_subaru_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen and tsukemen noodles; sets add fried rice, gyoza and kara-age.
osaka_subaru_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tonkotsu shoyu and seafood-and-pork-bone broths with chashu.
osaka_subaru_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–24:00, until sold out; open all year (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only, no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine inside (May 2026). 26 seats at counters (Tabelog). Smoking area: weekdays from 14:00, all day on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). One bowl of rice free, the second ¥150 (June 2026). Busy at lunch (June 2026). Opened 3 December 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_subaru_shin_osaka.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, iekei bowls and free big tsukemen till midnight] A 26-seat ramen counter two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open 11:00 to midnight every day since 2013. The ramen is in the iekei mould, a rich tonkotsu shoyu where you choose thick or thin noodles, firmness, strength and oil, with a free bowl of rice, "more like Hakata Tonkotsu Ramen than Yokohama Iekei" to one diner (September 2025). Many come for the tsukemen: thick noodles in a seafood and pork-bone dip, with the large 550 g portion free and up to 750 g on request (2026), though the dip can run short. Fast, filling and cash only; smoking is allowed in the afternoon on weekdays and all day at weekends.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 3 December 2013 (Tabelog). The listing links menyasubaru.com, which no longer resolved on 2026-11-01. Reviewers describe the style as "Yokohama-style" or iekei (2025–2026) and guess at a chain or franchise (June and August 2026); no other branch is named in any source read.
chef_bio.specialty: Iekei-style tonkotsu shoyu; tsukemen with free large portions.

anecdotes.text: "As always, I ordered the extra-large serving of 750 grams. One of the great things about this place is that you can choose your portion size for free." — June 2026, the tsukemen.
"The broth was rich with soy sauce flavor and very delicious. It felt more like Hakata Tonkotsu Ramen than Yokohama Iekei." — September 2025.
"After drinking at two places, I visited this restaurant for a late-night ramen fix for the first time." — June 2026, tonkotsu shoyu with thick noodles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 昴 新大阪店、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島3-23-9、西中島南方駅1番出口から2分、新大阪駅から徒歩7分、毎日11:00〜24:00、売り切れまで、年中無休、予約不可、現金のみ、26席 (カウンター)、分煙 (平日14時から、土日祝は終日喫煙可)、2013年12月3日オープン、サイトは menyasubaru.com (2026年11月1日はつながらない)。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年10月): 家系スタイルのとんこつ醤油、太麺か細麺、かたさ、味の濃さ、鶏油を選べる、ごはん1杯無料 (2杯目150円)、味玉のとんこつ塩980円、つけ麺は魚介と豚骨のつけ汁に太麺、並350g、大550g は無料、750g まで無料という声も、Super Rich Seafood Tsukemen SP 1,180円、半チャーハン、gyoza、kara-age のセット、昼は混む、チェーンかという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine (cash only); noodles, firmness and strength chosen when ordering. No English evidence found.

osaka_tokiya_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and chicken tsukemen dips of pork bone and seafood, with chashu.
osaka_tokiya_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:50 and 18:00–22:20; Sat and Sun 11:30–22:20 (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog); buy a ticket first, then join the line (October 2026). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, one table for 4 and two for 2; non-smoking; children, babies and strollers welcome (Tabelog). A line is normal, even on weekday evenings; it moves fast, about ten minutes for seven people at 21:00 (October 2026). Opened 10 March 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_tokiya_nishinakajima.notes: [Tsukemen · Nishinakajima, rich pork tsukemen since 2009] A 15-seat tsukemen shop between Nishinakajima-Minamigata and Shin-Osaka, open since 2009 and a Tabelog Ramen 100 pick every year from 2019 to 2025, with a line most lunchtimes and many evenings. The pork tsukemen is the reason: a very rich dip of pork bone and seafood with braised pork in it, so the shop's own instructions tell you to dip the smooth medium-thick noodles only lightly (October 2026); a lighter, slightly tangy chicken tsukemen is the alternative. Every bowl ends with a bite of rice to pour the last of the dip over. Buy your ticket before you queue; the line moves fast. Cash only. Open till 22:20, all day at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: opened 10 March 2009; social media posts on Facebook and Instagram "tend to be written for the entire group"; Tabelog Ramen WEST 100 2019–2022 and Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025. An October 2026 diner regrets that "the Tenma location closed down". Reviewers note a detailed written guide to the menu and to how lightly to dip (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork tsukemen; chicken tsukemen; rice for the leftover dip.

anecdotes.text: "What stood out to me was the detailed explanation of the menu and how to enjoy the tsukemen." — October 2026, the Toki Ya Special Pork Tsukemen for JPY 1,550.
"There was a line of seven people waiting at that hour, which shows how popular this place is." — October 2026, just before 21:00, seated in about ten minutes.
"The final broth rice was creamy and surprisingly good." — October 2026, the pork spicy tsukemen for JPY 1,150.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 時屋、つけ麺、食べログ ラーメン WEST 百名店 2019〜2022、ラーメン OSAKA 百名店 2023〜2025、大阪市淀川区西中島5-1-4 1F、西中島南方駅から約4分、阪急 南方駅から6分、JR 新大阪駅から約8分、月〜金11:30〜14:50、18:00〜22:20、土日11:30〜22:20、予約不可、現金のみ、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル8)、禁煙、子ども可、2009年3月10日オープン、SNS はグループ全体の記事が多い。口コミ(2026年10月〜11月): 先に食券を買って並ぶ、行列は早く進む、豚つけ麺は豚骨と魚介のとても濃いつけ汁に煮豚、Toki Ya Special Pork Tsukemen 1,550円、辛い豚つけ麺 (辛さ2) 1,150円、鶏つけ麺は少し酸味のあるさっぱりしたつけ汁、なめらかな中太麺、つけ汁は軽くつける、食べ方の説明、あぶったチャーシュー、半熟卵、かいわれ、最後に残ったつけ汁をかけるごはん、瓶ビール、Tenma の店は閉店。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine first, then the line; a written guide explains how to dip. No English evidence found.

osaka_kokokara_sakie_nishimiyahara.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles from Menya Teigaku in Kyoto (October 2026); the chashu bowl is topped with mayonnaise.
osaka_kokokara_sakie_nishimiyahara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: whole-chicken broths of Hinai and Men-suke chicken with pork chashu; seafood, squid and sanma bowls.

No reservations; cash only (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine at the entrance (2026). Counter and table seats; non-smoking (Tabelog); children's cutlery and table seats (October 2026). When busy, write your name on the list and come back (September 2026). Morning ramen once a month on the second Sunday, by lottery, until sold out; queue on the road side, not by the apartments; no preschool children when there is a queue outside (October 2026). Opened 9 June 2018 (Tabelog).
osaka_kokokara_sakie_nishimiyahara.notes: [Ramen · Nishimiyahara, whole-chicken shoyu from a Mutahiro alumnus] A bright, spotless chuka soba shop a ten-minute walk west of Shin-Osaka Station, opened in 2018 by a former manager of Chuka Soba Mutahiro (October 2026) and on Tabelog's Ramen 100 list from 2023 to 2025. The bowl to order is the marudori shoyu: a clear, chicken-oil-glossy broth of Hinai and Men-suke chicken, Kyoto noodles from Menya Teigaku, rare pork-shoulder chashu and Kujo green onion, ¥1,100–1,250 (October 2026). Specials change often (squid and niboshi, salt seafood, oil soba), and once a month on the second Sunday there is a lottery morning ramen, sanma in October 2026. One devotee has logged 155 visits (October 2026). The owner cooks each bowl; when it's busy, write your name and wander. Cash only; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: "opened in 2018 by the former manager of the renowned 'Chuka Soba Mutahiro' in Osaka"; "The owner was in the kitchen skillfully preparing each bowl with great care"; noodles from Menya Teigaku in Kyoto. Opened 9 June 2018; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Marudori (whole-chicken) shoyu ramen; monthly morning ramen.

anecdotes.text: "Wow, the broth, concentrated with the flavors of Hinai chicken and Men-suke chicken, is incredibly delicious!" — October 2026, a diner on visit 155, the marudori shoyu with flavoured egg for JPY 1,250.
"You can taste the essence of sanma even without its physical form." — October 2026, the monthly morning ramen, sanma and Hinai chicken for JPY 1,400.
"I found the noodles to be somewhat lacking. They just couldn't compete with the broth." — October 2026, the large marudori ramen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華そば ココカラサキゑ、ラーメン、食べログ ラーメン OSAKA 百名店 2023・2024・2025、大阪市淀川区西宮原1-7-39、JR・Midosuji 線 新大阪駅から徒歩10分、水〜日11:30〜14:30、18:00〜21:00、月・火休み、予約不可、現金のみ、カウンター、禁煙、2018年6月9日オープン。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): Chuka Soba Mutahiro の元店長が2018年に開いた店、Marudori 醤油 (Hinai の鶏) 1,100円、味玉1,250円、麺大盛り150円、Kujo ねぎ200円、特製はレアチャーシュー2枚、卵、肉ワンタン、メンマ、ねぎ、Hinai と Men-suke の鶏の澄んだスープに鶏油、「Chicken Day」は Rishiri の昆布としいたけのだしも、麺は Kyoto の Menya Teigaku の中細ストレート、豚肩ロースのレアチャーシュー、鶏チャーシューも、特製塩の魚介ラーメン、油そば、イカと煮干し、冷たいスルメのラーメン、毎月第2日曜の朝ラーメンは抽選でサンマと Hinai の鶏1,400円、チャーシュー丼480円、Sapporo Lager にメンマの小皿、入口の券売機、混んでいたら名前を書く、店主が一杯ずつ、155回通った人も、麺が物足りないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine at the entrance; a name list when busy; check Instagram for closures. No English evidence found.

osaka_shanimuni_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask when booking (the listing asks guests to state allergies). No gluten information. Binchotan-grilled skewers and eel come with tare, and the courses run through tempura, sushi and pudding; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_shanimuni_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, chicken skewers, eel and wagyu; the lunch is grilled meat on rice.
osaka_shanimuni_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00; Mon–Sat and holidays dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Sunday and some irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same-day too; say whether you want the counter or a private room; tell the shop about allergies and dislikes; two-hour limit at busy times; no children below elementary-school age; cancel at least two days ahead (Tabelog). Appetiser ¥770 and 10% service at dinner (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter of 9 and four private rooms, sunken seating, for 2 up to 20; smoking only in the private rooms, and not at lunch (Tabelog).
osaka_shanimuni_shinsaibashi.notes: [Robata · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, private rooms by the charcoal] A stylish, unmarked-looking robata restaurant on a quiet back street near Nagahoribashi: a counter in front of the binchotan where the chef grills, and four sunken private rooms behind it for two to twenty. Dinner is courses (¥9,900–12,100) or à la carte sashimi, skewers, grilled eel and seasonal small plates with a long sake list; finish with the wasanbon pudding. Weekday lunch is a grilled-meat box over rice for about ¥1,800. Diners describe a calm room, attentive staff and a gracious owner (2026). No young children; closed Sundays; add a ¥770 appetiser and 10% service at dinner.

roles: Owner and chef, unnamed in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: charcoal grilling over binchotan, a traditional Japanese method, with seasonal food gathered from around Japan and private rooms for up to 20. An October 2026 diner describes a thoughtful, beautiful owner and the chef working behind the counter; a January 2026 diner praised the women on the floor staff and a staff member who ran after the diner to return a forgotten item.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Enjoy the quality of the ingredients, the heart of the griller and the grilled food while it is still hot" (Tabelog shop text, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan-grilled skewers and eel; seasonal kaiseki courses; wasanbon pudding.

anecdotes.text: "I also appreciate the staff member who ran after me to return my forgotten item." — January 2026, a sake and sushi course with extra skewers.
"Instead of plain water, they offer delicious rooibos tea!" — October 2026, a third lunch visit.
"The only downside was that the Wasanbon Pudding for takeout was sold out" — July 2026, a colleague's wedding celebration.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): しゃにむに 心斎橋本店 (SHANIMUNI)、居酒屋・焼き鳥・うなぎ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-3-19 五興ビル 1F、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅6番出口から徒歩5分、月〜金11:30〜14:00、月〜土・祝17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 料理21:00、ドリンク21:30)、日曜休み、不定休あり、予約は当日も可、カウンターか個室か確認を、アレルギーや苦手なものは事前に、混雑時は2時間制、未就学児は不可、キャンセルは2日前まで、先付770円とサービス料10%、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、30席 (カウンター9、個室4)、個室のみ喫煙可、ランチは禁煙、厳選した備長炭でじっくり焼く、全国の旬の食材、基本のコース9,900円、特選会席「Kotobuki」12,100円、季節限定の会席「Roku」。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年10月): 刺身、炭火の串、ハラミ串、うなぎ、イチボ、タコと大根の煮物、ポテトサラダ、白子の天ぷら、手まり寿司、親子丼、和三盆プリン、平日ランチの焼肉定食1,800円、ハラミとカルビのお重、水のかわりにルイボスティー、カウンターの奥に掘りごたつの個室、気配りのあるきれいなオーナー。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses booked ahead, or à la carte at the counter (2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Tabelog listing: "If you have any food allergies or dislikes, please let us know."

osaka_kamofuku_hozenji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the meal finishes with handmade soba (or thick somen) and the hot pot broth and dips are soy-based; no gluten-free soba described. Ask when booking about allergies, as the listing invites.
osaka_kamofuku_hozenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck in every course and a duck or dashi broth for the soba.
osaka_kamofuku_hozenji.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–23:00; Mon 17:00–23:00 by reservation only, courses only; last order 22:00 (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Reservations accepted online or by phone; ask by phone if online shows full; two guests sit at the counter and three or more in a private room unless you ask; no charge for hot pot or course orders; tell the shop about allergies and dislikes (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 52 seats over two floors, counter, tatami and sunken private rooms for 2 to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). The second floor is shared with a neighbouring okonomiyaki restaurant (September 2026).
osaka_kamofuku_hozenji.notes: [Duck and soba · Hozenji Yokocho] A duck house in the north alley of Hozenji Yokocho serving Kyoto duck sent from Kyoto, with private rooms upstairs. At dinner the order is a duck course: tataki and duck ham, then grilled shabu-shabu of duck and Kujo green onion on a teppan (staff show you how), or the duck hot pot, finished with the handmade soba. Lunch is calmer and cheaper: oyakodon, a roast-duck box with a mini soba, or duck bukkake soba. Book for the private rooms; Monday nights are courses by reservation only. Expect ¥6,000–8,000 a head at dinner.

roles: Owner who chooses the sake (July 2026 review); unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: fresh Kyoto duck shipped directly from Kyoto, Kyoto duck hot pot, grilled shabu-shabu and sukiyaki, handmade soba and duck zosui at reasonable prices in Hozenji Yokocho. A July 2026 diner notes the sake was personally chosen by the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto duck grilled shabu-shabu; duck hot pot with handmade soba.

anecdotes.text: "At first, the staff grilled it for us and showed us how to do it, which was very helpful." — September 2026, the grilled shabu-shabu course with free drinks for JPY 7,500.
"It seems the second floor is shared by two restaurants, and I could smell okonomiyaki from the neighboring table..." — September 2026.
"The selection of sake was personally curated by the owner, and it was very tasty." — July 2026, the Kyoto duck shabu-shabu course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): かもふく、居酒屋・そば・鍋、大阪市中央区難波1-1-18 エチゲンビル 1〜2F、なんば駅から徒歩3分、千日前のラウンドワン横のアーケードを北へ、法善寺横丁の北側の路地の中ほど左手、火〜日11:30〜23:00、月17:00〜23:00 (予約のみ)、L.O. 22:00、予約可 (ネットで満席でも電話で空きがあることも)、2名はカウンター、3名以上は個室、鍋やコースはチャージなし、苦手なものやアレルギーは事前に、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、52席、個室 (2〜20名)、禁煙、京都から直送のKyoto の鴨、Kyoto の鴨鍋、Kyoto の鴨の焼きしゃぶ、Kyoto の鴨すき焼き、手打ちそば、鴨雑炊、Kyoto の鴨鍋コース6,710円、飲み放題付きコース7,500円。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): Kujo ねぎと鴨の焼きしゃぶをポン酢か自家製ごまだれで、スタッフが焼き方を教えてくれる、鴨のたたき、鴨の生ハム、鴨の茶碗蒸し、鴨串、締めはそば・雑炊・太めのそうめん、ランチの親子丼、ぶっかけそば、鴨ロースの重とミニそば、月曜はコースのみ、オーナーが選んだ日本酒、2階は隣のお好み焼き店と共有。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff show you how to grill the duck at the table (September–October 2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Tabelog listing: "Please let us know if you have any food dislikes or allergies."

osaka_les_celebrites_hotel_nikko.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Classic French courses with sauces, pâté en croûte, bread with two butters and a dessert trolley; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_les_celebrites_hotel_nikko.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of foie gras, fish, wagyu, lamb or pork with butter and cream sauces.
osaka_les_celebrites_hotel_nikko.hours_raw: Open only on Friday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays: lunch 11:30–14:30; dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30), on Saturday and the day before a holiday until 21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Monday to Thursday except holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; with a seat-only booking you choose the meal on the day (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, WAON and many QR payments (Tabelog). 28 seats and a private room for 10–20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; hotel parking (Tabelog).
osaka_les_celebrites_hotel_nikko.notes: [French · Shinsaibashi, a weekend hotel classic] The French restaurant of Hotel Nikko Osaka, three floors above Shinsaibashi Station, now open only Friday to Sunday and on holidays. The cooking is classic: pâté en croûte, bisque, Rossini-style wagyu with foie gras and truffle sauce, and a run of desserts ending with a trolley of petits fours you pick from. Courses ran ¥7,500–13,000 in 2025–2026 (¥10,000 on a February 2026 Friday), with a ¥32,000 luxury course, plus 15% service. Reviews in 2026 are mostly warm, though a July 2026 diner found the lamb and pork mains tough. Good for anniversaries; wheelchair accessible.

roles: Hotel Nikko Osaka; chef unnamed in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Reviewers call it a long-established French restaurant of Hotel Nikko Osaka; a March 2025 diner who had found the cooking had slipped noticed it improved and wondered whether the chef had changed. Open only on weekends and holidays (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Classic French courses; dessert trolley of petits fours.

anecdotes.text: "For this quantity and quality, the Friday price is JPY 10,000!" — February 2026.
"We could choose as many tea sweets as we liked from a wide selection!" — August 2026, a celebration on the middle course.
"The atmosphere is relatively casual for a hotel French restaurant. … However, the meat in the main course was tough" — July 2026, a lamb main.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): フランス料理 レ・セレブリテ ホテル日航大阪、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-3-3 ホテル日航大阪 3F、心斎橋駅8番出口直結、金・日・祝11:30〜14:30と17:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、土・祝前日は21:30まで (L.O. 21:00)、月〜木休み (祝日を除く)、予約可、席のみの予約は当日に料理を選ぶ、サービス料15%、カード・交通系IC・WAON・QR可、28席、個室10〜20名、禁煙、車いす可、駐車場あり。口コミ(2024年11月〜2026年9月): 週末と祝日だけの老舗フレンチ、コース7,500円・10,000円・13,000円 (2025年8月)、金曜のディナー10,000円 (2026年2月)、32,000円のエグゼクティブコース (2025年3月)、パテ・アン・クルート、オマールのビスク、和牛フィレのロッシーニ、ブイヤベース、2種のパンとバター、デザートが何皿も、好きなだけ選べる小菓子、2026年7月はメインの肉が硬かったという口コミも。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant with set courses; a choice of main and of petits fours at the table (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_zojirushi_shokudo_namba.gf_detail: Not safe for gluten avoidance: the listing says the restaurant cannot remove all allergens from its sourcing and cooking and does not accommodate food allergies. The rice itself is plain, but the mains and side dishes are seasoned.
osaka_zojirushi_shokudo_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every set is built around a fish or meat main with small side dishes such as sea bream and nori tsukudani, and allergy requests are not accommodated.
osaka_zojirushi_shokudo_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:15 and 17:00–21:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; at lunch take a numbered ticket (from about 10:30) and come back on the QR code; a 60-minute limit; 30-minute waits at noon on weekdays and weekends in 2026 (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, Edy, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 61 seats, all tables; non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu for preschoolers only, no children's chairs; parking at Namba Parks and Namba City (Tabelog). Opened 17 October 2018 (Tabelog). No allergy accommodation (Tabelog).
osaka_zojirushi_shokudo_namba.notes: [Set meals · Namba, a rice-cooker maker's dining room] The restaurant of the rice-cooker maker Zojirushi on the sixth floor of Namba Skyo, above Nankai Namba Station, where rice is the main course: two or three rices cooked in the company's top cooker, soft, firm and multigrain, to compare and refill as often as you like, with a fish or meat main and small sides. Finish with sea-bream chazuke and rice ice cream. Lunch sets start at ¥2,300 (October 2026); take a numbered ticket from about 10:30, as queues of 30 minutes are usual, and there is a 60-minute limit. The restaurant does not accommodate food allergies.

roles: Restaurant of Zojirushi Mahobin (Tabelog shop text); the listing links dynac-japan.com
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a rice restaurant by Zojirushi Mahobin, with rice blended by a five-star rice master and cooked in the "Enbutaiki" cooker that reproduces a traditional kamado; seasonal set meals at lunch and kaiseki at dinner; bento to take home. Opened 17 October 2018; a sister shop opened in Umeda (Tabelog 27152910 in the crawl). An October 2026 diner recalls long queues on the news at the opening.
chef_bio.specialty: Three rices with free refills; sea-bream chazuke; rice ice cream.

anecdotes.text: "I started checking in around 10:30. I was the 7th in line" — September 2026, a second visit, all three types of rice.
"However, the real reason I keep coming back to this place is for the dessert—rice ice cream." — October 2026.
"The only thing I would mention is that paying JPY 300 for one egg seems a bit pricey" — October 2026, seated at noon after a numbered ticket.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 象印食堂 大阪本店、食堂・日本料理・弁当、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 なんばスカイオ 6F、南海なんば駅から徒歩1分、月〜金11:00〜15:00と17:00〜21:00、土・日・祝11:00〜15:15と17:00〜21:00、予約可、食材の調達や調理でアレルゲンを完全に除けないためアレルギーには対応できない、カード・交通系IC・楽天Edy・iD・QUICPay・PayPay・au PAY・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、61席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙、子ども可 (キッズメニューは未就学児のみ、子ども用の椅子なし)、なんばパークスとなんばシティの駐車場、2018年10月17日オープン、象印のごはんレストラン、五つ星お米マイスターのブレンド米を「Enbutaiki」で、季節のおかず、ランチと会席、弁当、「Aki Hime 会席」飲み放題8,900円。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 10時半ごろから整理券と QR コード、60分制、ランチは2,300円から、鮭と大きな野菜の黒酢あん2,300円、ご飯は3種類をおかわり自由、鯛、梅干し、のりの佃煮、鯛茶漬け、ごはんアイス、卵は300円、クラフトビール「Zou no Mai」、平日も行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Numbered tickets and a QR code for the queue; staff explain the rices (September 2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Tabelog listing: "it is difficult to eliminate all allergens during the procurement of ingredients and the cooking process, so we are unable to accommodate food allergies."

osaka_zojirushi_shokudo_namba.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27106883/; cross-checked: GSI 大阪府大阪市中央区難波五丁目1番60号 (go) 11m. Same building as ぐり虎 大阪なんばスカイオ店 (osaka_guriko_namba_skyo, address_ja "難波5-1-60 なんばスカイオ 2F"), pinned 16 m away, so the two stay apart; 2026-11-01

osaka_tossa_ji_croissant_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The straw-grilled bonito is served with salt, garlic and other condiments, but set meals include obanzai in dashi and soy, and dinner courses run to pasta.
osaka_tossa_ji_croissant_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kochi seafood, bonito and yellowtail, with side dishes in dashi.
osaka_tossa_ji_croissant_kitahorie.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed on the 1st–4th Sundays, open on a 5th Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; lunch bookings until 13:45; table requests are not guaranteed, parties of two may be put at the counter; private rooms only by phone, with a course, for 5 or more (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 62 seats: 8 at the 1F counter, 22 at 1F tables, 32 on 2F, with private rooms for 5–32; some days only 1F is open; non-smoking; families with children often at weekends (Tabelog). Opened 6 January 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_tossa_ji_croissant_kitahorie.notes: [Kochi cooking · Kitahorie, straw-grilled bonito] A two-floor Kochi restaurant a minute from Yotsubashi Station where the bonito arrives from Tosa the same day and is seared to order over burning straw in the Tosa way, and from the counter you can watch the flames. Lunch is the draw: the obanzai set of straw-grilled bonito and fat Tosa yellowtail side by side, eaten with salt, garlic and green onion, with a run of dashi-rich small dishes and a raw egg for your rice (¥1,980 in October 2026). In the evening the menu turns Japanese-French around the same fish, with more than 20 sakes from Kochi and courses for groups. Diners find it pricey for lunch but worth it; book, especially Fridays. Closed most Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a creative restaurant using seasonal ingredients from Kochi (Tosa), cooked with French technique into a fusion of Japanese and Western flavours; bonito delivered the same day and straw-grilled to order; over 20 Kochi sakes, recommended by the staff; families with small children and parents' groups on Sundays. Opened 6 January 2017.
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-grilled bonito tataki; Tosa yellowtail.

anecdotes.text: "After placing my order, I was able to watch the straw grilling right in front of me, and it was quite impressive!!" — October 2026, the obanzai set.
"I had the Set Meal featuring a comparison of smoked bonito and Tosa yellowtail for JPY 1,980. It's highly recommended to eat it with salt" — September 2026.
"The grilled bonito is delicious, but the sashimi of yellowtail was truly amazing." — October 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): トッサ・ジ・クラッサン、居酒屋・海鮮・フレンチ、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-19、四ツ橋駅4番出口から徒歩1分、四つ橋筋から一本西の通り、月〜土11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)・17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、第1〜第4日曜休み (第5日曜は営業)、予約可 (ランチは13:45まで、2名はカウンターのことも、個室は電話で5名以上のコース)、チャージなし、カード・PayPay 可、62席 (1階カウンター8、テーブル22、2階32)、個室5〜32名、禁煙、2017年1月6日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): Kochi の旬の食材をフレンチの技で和洋折衷に、その日に Tosa からとれたかつおを注文ごとにわら焼き、Kochi の日本酒20種以上、日曜は子ども連れも多い。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): わら焼きのかつおと Tosa のぶりの食べくらべのおばんざい定食1,980円、塩で食べるのがおすすめ、目の前でわら焼き、小鉢、生卵、Tosa のぶりの海鮮丼、namero、ランチの瓶ビール800円、飲み放題つきのコース、すき焼き、パスタ、ランチにしては高いがおいしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunches; staff recommend sake to beginners (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

osaka_kinchakuya_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Shirasu bowls and sashimi come with soy-based sauces, and sets include tempura, croquettes and fried oysters.
osaka_kinchakuya_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya of shirasu, sashimi and fried fish.
osaka_kinchakuya_namba.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00; dinner 17:00–22:00 except Wednesday, when it closes after lunch (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the Shirasu Gozen set is limited (five a day in September 2026) and bookable (2026 reviews). Starter ¥380 at dinner (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and other e-money, and QR payments including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 33 seats at the counter, tables and outdoor tables; smoking only outside; private hire up to 40 (Tabelog). QR ordering (October 2026). In Namba CITY's Komejirushi food alley under the tracks, across from the South Building exit; directly connected from Nankai Namba Station south exit (Tabelog). Opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_kinchakuya_namba.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Namba CITY, Kishiwada shirasu] A lively little seafood izakaya in the Komejirushi alley under the Nankai tracks, the Namba branch of a Kishiwada fishing-port shop, with counter, tables and seats outside and festival music on the speakers. Shirasu comes straight from Kishiwada port, and the thing to order is the raw-shirasu bowl, ¥1,000 at lunch in October 2026, or the limited Shirasu Gozen with both raw and fluffy boiled shirasu, fried fish and a raw egg (¥1,600). At night there are assortments of the day's fish served in a masu, a 'senbero' set of beer and three small dishes, one-cup sakes and Kishiwada beer. Regulars come back several times a month; one found the portions small for men. Closed Wednesday evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator's site (ikari-f.co.jp): two directly run shops, きんちゃく家 岸和田店 and きんちゃく家 なんば店, serving fresh fish at low prices, including Osaka shirasu sent direct from Kishiwada fishing port. Tabelog: opened 6 April 2024; a sister of a famous shop in Kishiwada.
chef_bio.specialty: Raw-shirasu bowl; Shirasu Gozen.

anecdotes.text: "I've become hooked on fresh shirasu and this is my third visit this month." — September 2026, the raw-shirasu bowl.
"I arrived just as they opened, and the staff said, 'You made it just in time for our special limited offer of 5 servings!'" — September 2026, the Shirasu Gozen.
"The Senbero Set includes a draft beer and three daily specials. Today, it featured shirasu (young sardines) tsukudani, octopus wasabi, and tempura of kiss fish." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 運営会社のサイト (ikari-f.co.jp): きんちゃく家 岸和田店、きんちゃく家 なんば店、直営店だからできる新鮮な魚を低価格で、岸和田漁港直送の大阪産しらすなどとれたての海鮮を大阪市内で。食べログ (店舗会員): きんちゃく家 なんば店、海鮮・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市浪速区難波中2-10-25 なんばCITY なんばこめじるし、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、毎日11:00〜15:00、17:00〜22:00 (水曜は昼のみ)、お通し380円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、33席、屋外席、店内禁煙、貸切40名まで、2024年4月6日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 岸和田漁港直送の鮮魚、岸和田の有名店の姉妹店、海鮮丼、生しらすと釜揚げしらすの丼、3・5・10品の masu-mori のセット、ワンカップの日本酒9種、フローズンサワー、冬の海鮮鍋、お祭りの BGM。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 生しらすの丼1,000円 (大盛り+110〜120円)、釜揚げのしらす丼ランチ990円、Shirasu Gozen 1,600円 (1日5食)、きんちゃく家の定食1,600円、senbero のセット、軽く飲むセット1,100円、岸和田のビール、QR で注文、月に何度も来る常連、男性には少なめという声。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering; set lunches (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_tazya_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The lunch box includes kara-age and dashimaki, and the evening menu oden, dashi shabu-shabu and soba to finish, with a mirin-based pot sauce.
osaka_tazya_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: katsuobushi is shaved over most dishes, and the menu is pork, beef, fish and chicken in dashi.
osaka_tazya_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00; Sat and Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the limited "Jewel Box" lunch can be reserved by the day before on weekdays, in limited numbers at weekends; a 2-hour dinner and 1-hour lunch limit when busy (Tabelog). Starter ¥500 at dinner; private-room fee ¥500 a person at dinner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 34 seats on 2F: a main room of 24 and private rooms for 4, 6 and 8 (a gold "VIP" room); private hire up to 24–30; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Up a steep staircase behind a plain door (October 2026). Opened 10 May 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_tazya_namba.notes: [Izakaya · Ura-Namba, freshly shaved katsuobushi] A second-floor izakaya in the Ura-Namba back streets, up a steep staircase behind a plain door, built on vegetables from the company's own farm in Yao and katsuobushi shaved so thin it flies off the plate. At lunch it is famous on social media for the 'Jewel Box', a wooden treasure chest of sashimi, roast beef, kara-age, dashimaki and small dishes, with bonito flakes from Ibusuki for the rice without limit (¥2,590 in October 2026; book the day before). In the evening, try the deep-fried simmered daikon and the ¥3,800 course of dashi shabu-shabu with soba, ideally in the gold private room. One diner found the box pretty but unremarkable and the rice refills extra (October 2026). There is a sister restaurant, BELLA BOCCA, downstairs.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a hideaway izakaya for adults focused on genuine ingredients (vegetables from its own farm in Yao, where guests can join farm days; freshly shaved katsuobushi; Hokkaido free-range pork; a pot sauce made with three-year-aged mirin) and junmai sake; opened 10 May 2023. Operator kimiyu.co.jp. Reviews in October 2026 mention a sister on 1F, BELLA BOCCA, and an Umeda location.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The truly delicious meal is eating with a gentle mother and family" (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Jewel Box lunch; freshly shaved katsuobushi; fried simmered daikon.

anecdotes.text: "Be careful, as the katsuobushi is very thin and fluffy, so it might fly away! Haha." — October 2026, the house-tofu starter.
"I had the Gem Box Lunch for JPY 2,590, which was a hearty meal. The bonito flakes were all-you-can-eat" — October 2026.
"Although bonito flakes were available for unlimited refills, there was an extra charge for rice refills" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 達屋 なんば店 (TAZ-YA)、居酒屋・しゃぶしゃぶ、大阪市中央区難波千日前1-8 2F、月〜金11:30〜14:30・17:00〜23:00、土・日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、予約可、限定の Jewel Box のランチは平日は前日までに予約、週末は数量限定、混雑時はディナー2時間・ランチ1時間、お通し代500円・個室料1人500円 (ディナーのみ)、カード・PayPay 可、34席、2階、24席のホールと4・6・8名の個室 (VIP 個室)、貸切24〜30名、禁煙、2023年5月10日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 自社の農園の野菜、削りたてのかつお節、Hokkaido の放牧の豚、3年熟成の本みりんの鍋のたれ、純米酒、大人の隠れ家の居酒屋、Yao の自社農園の農業体験。会社のサイト (kimiyu.co.jp): 「優しいお母さんと家族と食べる食事」が一番おいしいもの。口コミ(2026年10月): Jewel Box のランチ2,590円 (刺身、ローストビーフ、唐揚げ、だし巻き、ポテサラ、おばんざい、Ibusuki のかつお節はおかわり自由、ご飯のおかわりは有料)、肉巻きのランチ、3,800円のコース (大根の揚げ煮、だしのしゃぶしゃぶ、締めのそば、サーモンとマグロの丼)、自家製の豆腐に目の前でかつお節、ジャスミンティーのプリン、金色の個室、急な階段、1階の姉妹店 BELLA BOCCA、Umeda にも店。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunch and courses; book the lunch box ahead (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_sumi_kara_sumi_made_higashishinsai.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with sauce or salt; the menu includes a wagyu katsu sandwich, spring rolls, kimbap and meat sushi with soy-based seasonings.
osaka_sumi_kara_sumi_made_higashishinsai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a charcoal grill of beef tongue, wagyu, duck and chicken.
osaka_sumi_kara_sumi_made_higashishinsai.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–23:00, last order 22:00, straight through with no break; closed on some days (Tabelog; August 2026). Reservations accepted; weekends fill with bookings (October 2026). Table charge ¥500 a person, none with a course (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 30 seats: an 8-seat counter on 1F, tables and sofa seats on 2F, a private room for 8–12; private hire up to 25; heated tobacco only (cigarettes not allowed from July 2026); free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Opened 2 February 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_sumi_kara_sumi_made_higashishinsai.notes: [Charcoal grill · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, beef tongue and Kawachi duck] A two-floor charcoal grill in the Galaxy building lanes of Higashi-Shinsaibashi, open straight from noon to 11 p.m., with a bar-like counter downstairs and tables and sofas upstairs. Despite the yakitori name the stars are beef tongue (a thick-cut 'toro' tongue skewer, a tongue tsukimi hamburg, tongue roast beef) and rare Kawachi duck, served as sashimi, roast or shabu-shabu in ichiban dashi, with creative plates like a black-wagyu katsu sandwich (¥2,200) and an assortment of meat sushi (¥1,750) in October 2026. It belongs with the Ura-Namba grill Black. Diners found it generous and stylish if a bit pricey and cramped; no cards, but PayPay works. Weekends book out.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: rare Kawachi duck through a unique route from a supplier with 150 years of history; thick-cut toro beef tongue; Kawachi duck roast and rare cutlet; kamo shabu-shabu in ichiban dashi; private rooms. Opened 2 February 2023. An August 2026 diner was told it is a sister of the charcoal-grill Italian Black in Ura-Namba.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut toro beef tongue; Kawachi duck; meat sushi.

anecdotes.text: "Like Black, there are no idle hours here, which makes this type of establishment quite rare." — August 2026, an Obon afternoon.
"My favorite was the Wagyu Beef Katsu Sandwich—this is a must-order!" — August 2026.
"Personally, I loved the Toro-Taku Kimbap and the thick-cut Toro Beef Tongue the most." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 炭焼きと焼き鳥 炭から隅まで 難波心斎橋店、焼き鳥・居酒屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-19 三ツ寺ギャラクシービル5号館 1F、心斎橋駅6番出口・なんば駅25番出口から徒歩約9分、毎日12:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、チャージ1人500円 (コースは無料)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、30席 (カウンター8、テーブル11、ソファ8)、8〜12名の個室、貸切25名まで、加熱式たばこのみ (2026年7月から紙巻きは不可)、Wi-Fi、2023年2月2日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 150年の歴史の仕入れ先から独自のルートで希少な Kawachi の鴨、厚切りの toro の牛タン、鴨のロースト、レアカツ、ichiban dashi の鴨しゃぶ、個室あり。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 白菜キムチ350円、牛タンの tsukimi ハンバーグ800円、牛タンのローストビーフ850円、黒毛和牛のカツサンド2,200円、肉寿司3種1,750円、もものタレ焼き650円、和牛の hiuchi のチンジャオロース1,200円、炭のポテトサラダ、しらすの鶏だし巻き、牛タンユッケの kimbap、トロたくの kimbap、牛タンのボロネーゼ春巻、昼から通し営業、姉妹店の Black、少し高く席がせまいという声、週末は予約で満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff help build an order to your budget (August 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_steak_devon_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Teppanyaki steak with several sauces, butter-grilled seafood with tartar, garlic rice seasoned with garlic soy sauce, crab fried rice or curry to finish; the staff checked each course dish for a pregnant diner (November 2025).
osaka_steak_devon_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kobe-beef and wagyu teppanyaki courses with seafood and butter.
osaka_steak_devon_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:30 (last order 22:00); Sat 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:00); closed Sundays and holidays; 12:00–17:00 by reservation made the day before (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted, with a call back to confirm; parties over eight by phone (Tabelog). Service charge 10%, no cover (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 36 seats: an eight-seat counter and four semi-private sofa booths for up to seven, each around its own teppan, screened from each other; non-smoking with a smoking room (Tabelog; official site). Founded 1970 (official site).
osaka_steak_devon_kitashinchi.notes: [Steak · Kitashinchi, Kobe-beef teppanyaki since 1970] A Kitashinchi steakhouse founded in 1970, on the fifth floor of a building where staff wait at the ground-floor lift and a cow greets you when the doors open (2024–25 reviews). Besides an eight-seat counter there are four sofa booths, each for up to seven around its own large teppan, screened from the next so it feels private, which makes it a choice for families and business dinners. A chef at each table grills Kobe beef and A5 Kyushu wagyu with seafood such as abalone, oysters or Ise lobster, alongside a sweet buttered whole potato and roasted garlic diners rave about, before garlic rice or crab fried rice. Courses run ¥14,850–22,000 plus 10% service; one diner felt the courses lacked seasonal touches for the price (March 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (devon1970.com, read 2026-11-02): founded in Kitashinchi in 1970, "a steakhouse that history speaks for", Kobe beef bought on the strength of long trading, a counter and sofa booths for up to seven around large teppan, partitioned so neighbours cannot see each other. Per Tabelog: a dedicated chef grills in front of you; Kyushu A5 wagyu and Kobe beef; dozens of wines.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Gratitude to our guests", handed down since 1970 (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe-beef teppanyaki; baked potato with butter; garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: "On the 5th floor of the Kitashinchi Building, you are greeted by a cow as the elevator doors open." — September 2025, the chef's recommended course for JPY 22,000.
"It was a very meaningful dinner." — November 2025; the staff asked about doneness each time and checked whether a pregnant diner could eat each dish.
"The roasted garlic was the best I've had among all the places I've tried!" — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ステーキハウス デボン、創業1970年、大阪・北新地、月〜金・祝前日17:00〜23:30 (L.O.22:00)、土17:00〜22:30 (L.O.21:00)、日・祝休み、お客様への「感謝の心」、長年の実績で仕入れる上質な神戸牛、シンプルな鉄板焼き、大きな鉄板を囲むソファー席は7名まで、パーテーションで区切った半個室、カウンター席。食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキ・鉄板焼き・焼肉、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-5-10 北新地地田ビル 5F、JR 東西線 北新地駅から徒歩1分、12時〜17時は前日までの予約で営業、予約は折り返しの電話で確認、8名以上は電話、サービス料10%、チャージなし、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、36席 (ボックス席4、カウンター8)、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、専属のシェフが目の前で焼く、Kyushu の A5 特選黒毛和牛ステーキ100gのコース14,850円、活け Ezo アワビと Akashi のタコと黒毛和牛の鉄板宴プラン18,150円、忘年会・新年会のコース17,600円 (4名から)、牛ヒレカツサンド、数十種のワイン。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年4月): デボンコース17,930円、シェフのおすすめコース22,000円、ローストビーフ、魚介のバター焼き、自家製タルタル、カキ、Ise の海老、アワビ、バターのじゃがいも、Aomori のにんにく、ガーリックライス、カニ玉チャーハン、ビーフピラフ、カレー、コーヒーとクッキー、エレベーターの前で牛が出迎える、妊娠中で料理を確認してくれた、季節感がもう少しほしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set teppanyaki courses cooked at the table; bookings confirmed by phone (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: November 2025 review: the staff checked whether a pregnant diner could eat each dish of the course.

osaka_vietnam_sakaba_bia_hoi_kakuda.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is rice-based (pho, bun, fresh spring rolls, fried rice), but fish sauce, soy-based sauces, fried spring rolls, banh mi and a beef dish in pastry are on it; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_vietnam_sakaba_bia_hoi_kakuda.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegan options" and "vegetarian options", but no vegan dish is named in the sources read; stir-fried water spinach and fresh herbs are on the menu, and most dishes use fish sauce, meat or seafood.
osaka_vietnam_sakaba_bia_hoi_kakuda.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Fri 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat 11:00–23:00; Sun 11:00–22:00; open all year; ask about holiday hours (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of 12 or more by phone (Tabelog); weekday lunch is often full with a queue, so book (October 2026). Order on your smartphone (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards and other e-money, QR payment including Alipay and WeChat Pay, plus Merpay and LINE Pay (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog's original text: なし). 82 seats including a small terrace; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 17 July 2001 (Tabelog).
osaka_vietnam_sakaba_bia_hoi_kakuda.notes: [Vietnamese · Umeda, a Vietnamese beer hall since 2001] A big, cheerful Vietnamese restaurant in a basement off Shin-Midosuji east of Umeda, open since 2001 and cooked by a chef from Vietnam, where one regular has eaten for over twenty years (October 2026). Weekday lunch is busy enough to queue: pho with beef tendon, bun cha with grilled meatballs, or a banh-mi-and-che buffet. In the evening come for Vietnamese beer with fresh and fried spring rolls, water spinach in garlic, banh xeo, lemongrass fried rice with shrimp and lettuce, stuffed squid or frog, all with as much free coriander as you like. Portions are large, so share. Ordering is by smartphone; drinks courses start at ¥4,800. An October 2026 diner noticed customers who seemed to be Vietnamese.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Vietnamese dishes by a Vietnamese chef, fresh spring rolls and pho, Vietnamese beer, wine, spirits and cocktails; opened 17 July 2001. The Tabelog invoice number T2120001243534 is registered to 株式会社カイセイソリューション, Nishitenma (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). An October 2026 diner has come for over 20 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Pho; fresh spring rolls; banh xeo; che.

anecdotes.text: "I've been coming to this place for over 20 years. I love the Banh Mi & Che buffet." — October 2026.
"I had been wishing for cilantro, even if it meant paying for it, and here it is for free. At this point, it feels divine." — October 2026.
"I made a reservation the day before just in case, but the restaurant was fully booked, and there was a long line outside." — October 2026, a weekday lunch.

osaka_torisho_kohnotori_sonezaki.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakitori with salt or sauce, chicken sashimi with sweet soy sauce, fried chicken, chicken-breast tempura, chicken nanban and rice bowls with sauce; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_torisho_kohnotori_sonezaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant; pickles and white-leek skewers sit beside chicken dishes.
osaka_torisho_kohnotori_sonezaki.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); lunch from 11:00, without skewers or grilled dishes (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; whole-shop hire for 20 or more (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog's original text: なし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards and other e-money, QR payment including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 20 table seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog). Opened 1 May 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_torisho_kohnotori_sonezaki.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Umeda, chicken from that morning] A bright, white-walled yakitori room opened in May 2025 at the Shin-Midosuji end of the street that runs from Ohatsu Tenjin, three minutes from Higashi-Umeda. Everything uses chicken slaughtered that morning, so the menu leans on the raw: a platter of four chicken sashimi with sweet soy, sesame oil and salt, liver sashimi, thigh tataki with ponzu. Skewers are ordered one at a time from about ¥300 (heart, thigh, neck, skin, a juicy tsukune with egg yolk), and diners liked the grilled thigh under fresh tomato salsa and the potato salad. Courses start at ¥4,000. Smoking is allowed; there is a menu in English, Chinese and Korean.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh chicken dishes from "morning-caught" chicken, from yakitori and fried chicken to sashimi, oyakodon and yakitori bowls; skewers ordered from one stick; sake and wine from dry to sweet; opened 1 May 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi platter; yakitori by the skewer.

anecdotes.text: "The chicken sashimi comes beautifully arranged with four generous portions, instantly raising your excitement when it arrives." — May 2026.
"The large piece of chicken is topped with a generous amount of salsa sauce. … The sauce, made with plenty of fresh tomatoes, is refreshing" — May 2026, the grilled chicken thigh.
"This yakitori restaurant opened in May 2025 and features an impressive high-end space with a white color scheme." — August 2026.
