osaka_kani_akane_sonezaki.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Crab courses with a dashi hotpot finished with udon, tempura in the premium courses, chawanmushi with a starchy sauce and crab vinegar.
osaka_kani_akane_sonezaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: crab kaiseki built on crab and dashi.
osaka_kani_akane_sonezaki.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no cancellations by phone outside business hours (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats, all in private rooms for two to eight; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 30 July 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_kani_akane_sonezaki.notes: [Crab kaiseki · Higashi-Umeda, crab in private rooms] A crab restaurant on the fifth floor of a building just off the Ohatsu Tenjin shopping street, opened in July 2025, where every table is a private room for two to eight. The kaiseki is crab from start to finish: a chilled tofu with crab, snow-crab sashimi with crab vinegar, a thick grilled leg, a crab chawanmushi, then the main snow-crab hotpot in dashi, finished with udon, for ¥7,800, with tempura added at ¥9,800 and a grilled leg of ibaragani at ¥14,800. Diners in 2026 praise the meaty legs and the calm rooms for dates and business meals; one learned the sashimi crab was frozen Russian crab (October 2026). Lunch and dinner every day, plus 10% service.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a variety of crab dishes from carefully selected brand crab, crab kaiseki in fully private rooms, for entertaining clients, celebrations and dates; opened 30 July 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Snow-crab hotpot kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: "The crab sashimi was reportedly made from frozen Russian crab, and it had a flavorful and delicious taste." — October 2026, the premium crab kaiseki at lunch for JPY 9,800.
"After taking the elevator to the 5th floor, I found the entrance to a sushi restaurant, wondering if my destination was further inside." — September 2026.
"The main dish, the crab hot pot, was served with a flavorful broth, and we finished with udon noodles." — October 2026, the JPY 7,800 course.

osaka_tako_tako_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki and akashiyaki are a wheat batter; tenkasu inside (April 2026).
osaka_tako_tako_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki, akashiyaki in dashi, grilled squid.
osaka_tako_tako_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reviews mention last orders around 21:00–21:30 (2025–2026), so go before then. No cards or e-money; QR payment accepted (Tabelog). 9 counter seats, plus takeaway; non-smoking (Tabelog). A takeaway line forms in the evening, while eat-in seats fill by 21:00 (December 2025, May 2026). Akashiyaki takes a while, so order it early (August 2026).
osaka_tako_tako_higashimikuni.notes: [Takoyaki · Higashi-Mikuni, a station-side counter for decades] A nine-seat takoyaki counter by the south exit of Higashi-Mikuni Station, around 30 years old by one regular's count (May 2026; another says over 40), with a takeaway window that draws a line in the evenings. The takoyaki are the old Osaka kind, small, crisp outside and creamy inside, lightly sauced, ten for ¥700; there is also shiso-yaki, a plain shiroyaki, akashiyaki in broth (order it early) and grilled squid from ¥300. Sit at the counter with a ¥550 highball and watch the owner work the griddles. The walls carry celebrity signatures, and diners say the singer aiko came here before debuting (2025–2026). Open until late; no cards.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: takoyaki, 9 counter seats, takeaway. Per reviews: "this long-established shop has been around for about 30 years" (May 2026); "Over 40 Years of Tradition in Takoyaki" and "The walls are adorned with signatures from various celebrities" (April 2026); "It seems that this place was often visited by the singer aiko during [the singer’s] student days, as there was a signed photo displayed" (July 2025); "well-known as the place aiko frequented before [the] debut" (May 2026); "I watched the back of the owner, sweating" at the griddle (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Small Osaka-style takoyaki; akashiyaki; grilled squid.

anecdotes.text: "Recently, there has been a trend towards larger and fluffier takoyaki, but I find joy in [the shop’s] small, simple takoyaki. Crispy on the outside and gooey on the inside." — May 2026.
"It seems that this place was often visited by the singer aiko during [the singer’s] student days, as there was a signed photo displayed." — July 2025.
"Before 8 PM, there were plenty of seats available, but by 9 PM, it was completely full! The takeout line was also quite long." — December 2025.

osaka_fu_lai_mala_tang_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. You choose the noodles (vermicelli, thick vermicelli, corn noodles, spinach noodles or Chinese wheat noodles) and toppings such as fish balls, dumplings and cheese tteokbokki, in one of three broths whose ingredients are not described.
osaka_fu_lai_mala_tang_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Ask. Many of the ingredients you pick are vegetables, mushrooms, tofu skin and noodles, but none of the three broths (traditional, golden, sesame "sticky") is described, and fish balls, shrimp and meat sit on the same counter.
osaka_fu_lai_mala_tang_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch lines on weekdays (May and September 2026). Pick ingredients by bamboo tag from a display of samples at the door, hand them over, and the kitchen cooks the bowl; priced per tag, not by weight (2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats: 4 at the counter and 6 tables for two; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Delivery via Uber (September 2026). Opened 22 February 2026 (Tabelog).
osaka_fu_lai_mala_tang_nishinakajima.notes: [Mala tang · Nishinakajima, a pick-your-own spicy soup shop with pandas] A 16-seat mala tang shop near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, opened in February 2026 and already lined up at lunch. Instead of weighing a self-served bowl, you pick bamboo tags from a display of samples, each tag a fixed portion from ¥100, and the kitchen cooks it: vegetables, mushrooms, tofu skin, fish balls, dumplings and a choice of five noodles. Then choose the broth, a classic spicy mala, a milder golden one, or a thick sesame "sticky" broth, and a spice level; level 2 is properly hot (2026). A full bowl runs about ¥1,300–2,000. Panda decor, panda mochi for dessert. One regular found the spice and the order inconsistent once (September 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: mala tang (listed as tantanmen), opened 22 February 2026. Per reviews: "Instead of the typical weight-based selling style, [the shop uses] a method where you select bamboo tags while looking at food samples" (October 2026); "The staff are incredibly kind" (October 2026); "The staff provided a thorough explanation" (May 2026); the shop is themed around pandas, with panda aprons and panda sweets (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Mala tang by bamboo tag; sesame "sticky" broth.

anecdotes.text: "Most of the ingredients and noodles are JPY 100, so the soup feels a bit pricey in comparison—what a strange phenomenon!" — March 2026.
"While Mala Tang typically features a light broth, this version is rich and thick, infused with a generous amount of sesame and a spicy kick from the chili." — September 2026.
"I ordered my usual Tradition 2, but it was clearly different in spiciness this time." — September 2026, a sixth visit.

osaka_namban_shokudo_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: chicken nanban, kara-age and chicken katsu are battered or breaded and fried; the kara-age is soy-flavoured (June 2026).
osaka_namban_shokudo_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken set-meal shop; tartar sauce, miso soup, keema curry.
osaka_namban_shokudo_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:40); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch lines before noon on weekdays (June 2026, December 2025); order on your phone by QR code, even while waiting in line, and pay by card on screen (2024–2026); the old ticket machine is gone (June 2024). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 16 seats: 4 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 1 September 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_namban_shokudo_higashimikuni.notes: [Set meals · Higashi-Mikuni, chicken nanban for office lunches] A 16-seat chicken nanban specialist two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station, open since 2009, full before noon on weekdays with office workers and tradesmen (June 2026). You order on your phone by QR code, even while in line. The chicken nanban comes as breast, juicy and tender, or thigh, fried, dipped in sweet vinegar and covered in homemade tartar; the mix adds kara-age (¥1,650), and plain sets are ¥1,300. Large rice is free and there is stir-fried takana on the table to stretch it, plus a jar of "Maximum" seasoning. Keema curry with a chicken nanban on top is the other draw. One diner credits Miyazaki chicken for the flavour (December 2025). Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: cafeteria and curry, opened 1 September 2009. Per reviews: "a Chicken Nanban specialty set meal restaurant" with "an atmosphere reminiscent of an old-fashioned set meal restaurant" (June 2026); "As expected, it's chicken from Miyazaki!" (December 2025); "Maximum seasoning, which is popular among camping enthusiasts and locals from Miyazaki" (May 2026); the order system moved from a ticket machine to phone ordering in 2024 (June 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken nanban with homemade tartar; keema curry.

anecdotes.text: "Orders are placed via QR code. It seems you can order on your smartphone while waiting in line." — June 2026.
"It's a popular place with a wait of 7 people. After about 15 minutes, I was seated … my food arrived in just 2 minutes after sitting down." — December 2025, chicken nanban mix.
"I decided to try the curry for the first time, and it was packed with more meat than I expected! Mixing in a bit of tartar sauce made it incredibly delicious!" — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 南蛮食堂 東三国店、食堂・カレー、大阪市淀川区東三国4丁目16-16、東三国駅から徒歩2分、JR 新大阪駅から10分、月〜土11:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:40)、日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay も) 可、16席 (カウンター4、テーブル12)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト、2009年9月1日オープン。口コミ(2023年5月〜2026年8月): チキン南蛮の定食の専門店、むねかももを選ぶ、甘酢と自家製タルタル、チキン南蛮定食1,300円、むね・もも・kara-age のミックス1,650円、kara-age 定食5個1,300円、チキンカツ定食、キーマカレー、チキン南蛮のせカレー、ごはん大盛り無料、卓上の高菜炒め食べ放題、玉ねぎとごまのドレッシング、卓上の Maximum (店でも880円で販売)、スマホの QR コードで注文、昼前から行列、生ビール550円、Miyazaki の鶏という声。

osaka_bara_no_ki_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried shrimp, tonkatsu, cutlets and croquettes in breadcrumbs, demi-glace sauce, and Neapolitan pasta.
osaka_bara_no_ki_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, fried shrimp, pork cutlets, sausages.
osaka_bara_no_ki_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only at lunch; at dinner cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats, about five tables for four (February 2025); non-smoking (Tabelog). Lunch is served quickly; self-service miso soup with refills (2024–2026). Reopened in July 2024 after a closure and renovation (October 2024 review).
osaka_bara_no_ki_higashimikuni.notes: [Yoshoku · Higashi-Mikuni, a neighbourhood western-food house] A small yoshoku restaurant two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station that closed for a while and reopened in July 2024 after a renovation, now clean and calm with soft music. Lunch is the reason to come: the house "Bara no Ki Lunch" of a small hamburg steak and crisp butterflied fried shrimp for about ¥1,000, or tonkatsu with demi-glace, ginger pork and katsu curry, with self-service miso soup that one diner rated the best part (October 2024). In the evening it becomes a small bistro-izakaya with Sanriku fried oysters, ajillo, sausages and Peroni. Portions are on the modest side (2024). Cash only at lunch; closed Sundays.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); two staff per reviews
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: yoshoku, 20 seats, lunch cash only. Per reviews: before the closure, "the owner manages everything alone" (October 2023); after reopening, "The master and a lady in the hall were managing the place" (September 2024) and "The staff consists of two men responsible for both service and cooking … The service was attentive, giving off a feeling of experience and professionalism" (October 2024); "I heard that [the restaurant] had been closed for a while, but [it] reopened in July of this year" (October 2024); the menu was narrowed to four lunches by September 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak and fried shrimp lunch.

anecdotes.text: "Overall, the plate was well-balanced, but the standout was the miso soup. It had a perfect saltiness and temperature … of course, I went for a refill." — October 2024.
"I tried the fried oysters from Sanriku (JPY 1000). They were freshly fried and bursting with the rich flavor of the oysters. The homemade tartar sauce was a nice touch." — February 2025.
"The menu features only the Bara no Ki Lunch, Tonkatsu Lunch, Katsu Curry, and Ginger Pork Lunch." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バラの木、洋食、大阪市淀川区東三国4-16-15 クイーンハイツ、東三国駅から130m、月〜土11:00〜14:00、17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、昼は現金のみ、カード・電子マネー可、20席、禁煙。口コミ(2023年10月〜2026年9月): 休業のあと2024年7月に改装して再開、小さなハンバーグとエビフライのバラの木ランチ1,000円、デミグラスのとんかつランチ、生姜焼き、カツカレー、ヒレカツランチ、ナポリタン、ごはん大盛り無料、みそ汁はセルフでおかわり自由、夜は前菜3種800円、フライドポテト、Sanriku のカキフライ1,000円、エビとしらすのアヒージョ900円、Iwate の豚のソーセージ、ガーリックトースト、生ハム、Kagoshima の鶏の kara-age のライスセット1,200円、Peroni、角ハイボール、量はひかえめ、静かな BGM。

osaka_malaysia_boleh_oyodo.gf_detail: Ask; the shop takes allergy requests for courses (official site). No gluten information. Noodle dishes (mee goreng, curry noodles with wheat noodles, spicy seafood thick noodles) contain wheat; fried rice, curries and satay use sauces whose ingredients are not listed.
osaka_malaysia_boleh_oyodo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the menu has vegetable dishes such as stir-fried water spinach and spicy eggplant salad, but the water spinach is cooked with belacan (shrimp paste) per the official site, and curries and noodles often use shrimp or fish seasonings.
osaka_malaysia_boleh_oyodo.hours_raw: Wed–Mon 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday (official site; Tabelog). Two-hour limit at busy times (Tabelog). Lunch queues around 12:30–13:00 (September 2026). Course bookings from two people, in advance (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, PayPay, d Barai, au PAY (official site; Tabelog). 26 seats (tables and a small counter); private hire for about 30; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). The official site announces a price revision from 1 December (year not given).
osaka_malaysia_boleh_oyodo.notes: [Malaysian · by Umeda Sky Building, Nyonya cooking] A small Malaysian restaurant facing the Umeda Sky Building, which calls itself Osaka's only Malaysian restaurant and has been open about twenty years, per a September 2026 diner. The cooking is based on Nyonya (Chinese-Malay) dishes, made with seasonings the shop brings back from Malaysia each year; the official site says it uses halal-marked seasonings and ingredients so Muslim guests can eat with peace of mind, and Tabelog lists many halal dishes, though it is not described as certified and alcohol is served. Lunch is the bargain, about ¥1,000 for nasi goreng, mee goreng or curry noodles with soup, salad and tapioca, and a queue forms around 12:30. Evening courses start at ¥4,200 (satay, tom yum goong, water spinach with belacan, chicken curry, spicy seafood noodles). Friendly staff who remember regulars. Closed Tuesdays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; signs a notice on the official site)
chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-02): "大阪唯一のマレーシア料理店" (Osaka's only Malaysian restaurant); Nyonya cooking, a fusion of Chinese and Malay food, with many halal dishes; seasonings bought in Malaysia every year to reproduce the authentic taste; "ハラールマーク付きの調味料や食材を使用しておりますので、イスラム教徒のお客様にも安心して" (halal-marked seasonings and ingredients, so Muslim guests can eat with peace of mind); a room decorated with Malaysian goods. A September 2026 diner writes it seems to have been in business for about 20 years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Malaysian taste, made so that every guest can eat with peace of mind (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Nasi goreng and mee goreng lunches; satay; Penang course.

anecdotes.text: "The staff remembered me, and it felt just like old times." — September 2026, the kapao rice.
"I arrived at 12:30, but there was a line, so I wandered around for a bit... Even after returning around 1 PM, the line was still there." — 17 September 2026.
"The meal came with a salad and dessert, tapioca, all for JPY 1000." — September 2026, the curry noodles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: マレーシア ボレ、大阪唯一のマレーシア料理店、スカイビルとうめきたの近く、中華とマレーの料理が融合したニョニャ料理がベース、ハラール対応メニューも豊富、毎年マレーシアで調味料を仕入れ、ハラールマーク付きの調味料や食材を使用、サテー、空芯菜のブラチャン炒め、えびの入ったピリ辛の太麺、ペナンコース4,200円 (クルポ、豆腐卵巻きサラダ、サテー、トムヤムクン、空芯菜、チキンカレー＆ライス、海鮮ピリ辛太麺、本日のデザート、2名から事前予約、アレルギーは相談を)、大阪市北区大淀南1-4-20、11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、火曜定休、カード・交通系電子マネー・PayPay・d払い・au PAY 可、12月1日から価格改定のお知らせ。食べログ (店舗会員): マラッカコース4,700円、飲み放題つきのマカンコース5,000円、26席、禁煙、子ども歓迎、混雑時は2時間制、ハラールとベジタリアンのオプション。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from a menu of Malaysian dishes; staff explain the menu (September 2026). A September 2026 diner found few tourists. No English menu listed.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Official site (Penang course): "アレルギーや食べられないものがありましたらご相談下さい" (consult the shop about allergies and foods you cannot eat).

osaka_mimoza_ohatsu_tenjin.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses centre on pasta, gnocchi, pizza and baguette with the ajillo (2026 reviews).
osaka_mimoza_ohatsu_tenjin.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Courses are built on fish from the market, beef and pork, with cheese sauces and parfaits.
osaka_mimoza_ohatsu_tenjin.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 (last order food 13:30) and 17:00–22:30 (last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30 (Tabelog). Bookings lapse 15 minutes after the reserved time without contact; same-day bookings within an hour by phone (Tabelog). A 90-minute limit was given on one October 2026 booking. Cover (otoshi) ¥380; a 10% year-end surcharge from early December to 5 January (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats (30 standing); non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 2 September 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_mimoza_ohatsu_tenjin.notes: [Italian · Ohatsu Tenjin, a young chef's homemade Italian] A twenty-seat second-floor Italian a minute from the Ohatsu Tenjin shrine, opened in September 2025, where a young chef from a well-known restaurant makes everything in house. Most 2026 diners came for the girls'-night course (¥6,000, ¥6,500 for men) with all-you-can-drink sparkling and wine: three appetizers, an ajillo good enough to mop up with baguette, the house pasta, a pork steak and gnocchi in cheese sauce, then a parfait. Lunch is a ¥2,200 pasta or pizza set, with appetizers or a steak as add-ons. Birthdays get the lights dimmed and music for the plate. Complaints: a lunch price rise and thin pasta (October 2026), and a 90-minute booking that ended before the main was finished.

roles: Chef (unnamed), young, trained at a well-known restaurant (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): stylish Italian a minute from Ohatsu Tenjin; authentic Italian with seasonal ingredients; everything homemade from appetizers to desserts; "Passionate Italian Cuisine by a Young Chef from a Renowned Restaurant"; wines and cocktails selected by the chef. Opened 2 September 2025. An October 2026 diner booked here was moved by phone to the restaurant's "second location nearby".
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal produce, everything homemade (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Girls'-night course; gnocchi with cheese sauce.

anecdotes.text: "Suddenly, the lights went out, and Disney-like music started playing" as a birthday plate came out — September 2026.
"The ajillo was so delicious that I could almost drink the oil, and I wanted to ask for more baguette." — October 2026, the girls'-night course.
"The main dish arrived just 15 minutes before I was supposed to leave" — October 2026, a booking with a 90-minute limit.

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses or lunch sets (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_jizake_dining_yasu_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu includes fresh pasta, maitake tempura and spiced fried eggplant; sashimi, sushi rolls and shirako ponzu are usually eaten with soy-based sauces containing wheat.
osaka_jizake_dining_yasu_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and sake izakaya (sashimi, sushi rolls, shirako, clams, yukke).
osaka_jizake_dining_yasu_doyama.hours_raw: From 18:00 until closing, no fixed end; closing days not fixed; bookings outside these hours by arrangement, including lunch, late-night and early-morning private hire (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; often fully booked (2026 reviews). Prices shown before tax; no service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 at tables (tables by reservation; parties of 2–3 may be seated at the counter); private hire for 7–15; smoking allowed; bring-your-own drinks (Tabelog). Opened 15 June 2019 (Tabelog).
osaka_jizake_dining_yasu_doyama.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, Higashi-dori, fish and sake on a third floor] A fourteen-seat izakaya up in a building just off Higashi-dori, hard to find on a first visit and usually full, where a young, lively crowd orders generous seafood and local sake. The dishes diners keep naming are the toro-taku roll (thin rolls that look like thick ones), shirako with ponzu, a heaped sashimi platter, maitake tempura and, unexpectedly, fresh pasta. Portions are big, so two people should order by halves; spending runs ¥5,000–10,000 with a few drinks. The sake list explains each bottle's character. Downsides in 2026 reviews: smoking allowed, tight seats (one diner sat on a beer crate with a cushion), a bleach smell on entry one October evening, and sashimi that one regular suspected was pre-sliced.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): local sake including kimoto-style and aged sakes; fresh pasta; banquets and private hire for 7–15; creative dishes to hot pots, tailored to budget and requests. Opened 15 June 2019.
chef_bio.philosophy: Accommodate customers' requests as much as possible (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Toro-taku roll; shirako ponzu; local sake.

anecdotes.text: "What looks like a thick roll turns out to be a thin roll. Everything is served in generous portions, so I recommend ordering half for two people!" — September 2026.
"The menu also includes descriptions of the sake's characteristics, making it easier to choose." — October 2026.
"Sitting on a cushion with the plastic box containing the beer was a bit uncomfortable for my backside, though (laughs)." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Small, busy counter; a sake list with tasting notes (October 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_oniku_takumi_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include a chateaubriand katsu sandwich (bread and breading), cold noodles, beef curry and meat grilled with tare, which is usually soy-based with wheat; ask for salt-grilled cuts.
osaka_oniku_takumi_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant of Omi beef, with oxtail soup.
osaka_oniku_takumi_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Daily from 17:00, closing time not given; lunch on request; open Sundays and holidays; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Courses can be booked 12:00–24:30 (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Service charge 8%; bring-your-own wine ¥3,000 a bottle; free birthday or anniversary plate (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 16 seats: 4 at the counter, 12 at tables, semi-private rooms for 2 and 4; smoking allowed, though guests may be asked to refrain (Tabelog). Opened 16 October 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_oniku_takumi_kitashinchi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kitashinchi, Omi beef grilled for you] A basement yakiniku room in Kitashinchi where you don't touch the grill: on the courses, staff cook each cut of Omi beef in front of you and bring it to the table at its peak, between appetizers and an oxtail soup simmered for half a day. The ¥15,000 course runs from tongue and strip loin through horumon to gyudon and cold noodles; the ¥18,000 course adds a rare chateaubriand katsu sandwich that diners call the best thing on the menu. À la carte is now possible, and in June 2026 the owner came to grill one table's sirloin. Wines come from France and Italy; 8% service. Semi-private rooms suit business dinners; smoking is allowed, and one December 2025 diner was put off by loud regulars.

roles: Owner (unnamed; grilled at the table in a June 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a high-end yakiniku restaurant a short walk from Kitashinchi Station; top-quality wagyu, Omi beef the speciality; courses in which staff grill the meat in front of the guest; wines sourced directly from France and Italy; a homemade oxtail soup simmered 12–13 hours. Opened 16 October 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: Great emphasis on the meat selection, cutting technique and grilling (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omi beef course; chateaubriand katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: "Since it was an attended course, I didn't have to cook, which made it so easy to enjoy my meal." — December 2024, a fifth visit.
"The katsu sandwich was especially outstanding." — October 2026.
"I was particularly impressed by the rice topped with meat and egg yolk—it was simply amazing!" — January 2026, course A.

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill the meat and explain each cut on courses (2024–2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_masamori_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba and udon in a soy-sauce broth, served in sets with katsu-don, tempura bowls or kara-age; the soba's buckwheat ratio is not stated.
osaka_masamori_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba and udon in dashi broth, with katsu-don, shrimp tempura or fried chicken in the sets.
osaka_masamori_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch only. No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). 20 seats (Tabelog): shared tables for four downstairs and a tatami room upstairs (August and September 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Full of office workers from just before noon, but tables turn over fast (2025–2026).
osaka_masamori_nishinakajima.notes: [Soba · Nishinakajima, the office workers' lunch soba house] A busy lunch-only soba and udon shop on a back street behind the APA Hotel in Nishinakajima, filled from before noon with office workers at shared tables and turning them over fast. The draw is the set meal: warm or cold soba or udon with a mini katsu-don, a mini tempura bowl or inari, around ¥850–980 (2025–2026), in portions that leave even big eaters full. The broth is slightly sweet soy, the fried tofu sweet, and the soba has a fair buckwheat flavour (2025). Plain zaru soba is ¥750 (April 2026). Three cooks and four floor staff work the rush (May 2026), and a tatami room upstairs takes the overflow. Cash only; 11:00–14:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: "There were three people in the kitchen and four serving staff, all busy at work" (May 2026); "the charm of a local soba shop" (February 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Soba or udon set with mini katsu-don or tempura bowl.

anecdotes.text: "Despite it being just before noon, the place was already about 80% full, and it reached full capacity while I was eating." — May 2026, the katsu-don set with mini soba for JPY 940.
"I forgot that in Osaka, Tanuki and Kitsune are the opposite." — June 2025, the chilled tanuki soba for JPY 860.
"I was impressed by the delicious broth! It had a slightly sweet soy sauce flavor that suited my taste perfectly." — September 2026, the Ume set with warm soba for JPY 960.

osaka_daiya_takoyaki_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki is a wheat batter, and yakisoba and curry udon are wheat noodles.
osaka_daiya_takoyaki_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: takoyaki with octopus, horumon, oden in broth.
osaka_daiya_takoyaki_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Closed on rainy days (September 2026). Not always open on the dot: one November 2025 diner arrived at opening and waited about 30 minutes while the couple prepared. No reservations; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 4 counter seats inside (Tabelog), plus outdoor counters and about four tables for around ten (2025–2026), with electric blankets and cushions in winter (February 2026); smoking allowed; takeaway (Tabelog). A July 2024 diner waited an hour. Opened 22 November 2010 (Tabelog).
osaka_daiya_takoyaki_higashimikuni.notes: [Takoyaki · Higashimikuni, a couple's stand with outdoor tables] A tiny takoyaki stand a minute from Higashimikuni Station, run since 2010 by a warm older couple (2024–2026), with four seats inside and a handful of outdoor tables where you eat and drink under the evening sky, blankets supplied in winter (February 2026). The takoyaki are big, golf-ball size, crisp outside and creamy inside, in flavours from classic sauce and mayonnaise to dashi soy, ponzu, curry and garlic pepper mayo; spicy horumon and horumon yakisoba go with a beer. Six takoyaki, horumon and two beers came to ¥1,650 (May 2026). The walls are covered in signed boards from stage actors, including the cast of The Prince of Tennis, and a railway YouTuber has sent fans here (2025). Evenings only; closed when it rains.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 22 November 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "This takoyaki shop is run by a couple" (September 2026); "The owners, an older gentleman and lady, are very kind" (November 2024); "The owner and the lady of the house are super kind!" (April 2026); the walls are covered with signed boards and goods from stage actors, among them the cast of "The Prince of Tennis" (October 2025, September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Large takoyaki in many flavours; spicy horumon.

anecdotes.text: "It felt like outdoor dining" — February 2026; electric blankets, cushions and a lap blanket made it comfortable for drinks.
"I had 6 takoyaki, spicy horumon, and 2 Asahi SUPER DRY for JPY 1,650, which is a great value!" — May 2026.
"This place seems to be a hotspot for fans of 'The Prince of Tennis,' as it displays signatures from the cast." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 大屋、たこ焼き・焼きそば、大阪市淀川区宮原5-2-17、東三国駅5番出口から徒歩1分、毎日18:00〜23:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、4席 (カウンター)、喫煙可、テイクアウト、2010年11月22日オープン。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年9月): 夫婦で切り盛り、やさしい年配の夫婦、雨の日は休み、外のカウンターとテーブル4つほど、冬は電気毛布とクッション、ゴルフボールより少し大きいたこ焼き、外はカリッと中はとろり、ソースマヨ、だし醤油、ポン酢、カレー、ガーリックペッパーマヨ、辛いホルモン、ホルモン焼きそば、おでん、カレーうどん、6個と辛いホルモンとビール2本で1,650円、舞台の俳優のサイン、「The Prince of Tennis」のキャスト、鉄道の YouTuber のおすすめ、開店時間でもまだ準備中の日も。

cultural_comfort.note: A street stand: order at the counter, eat outside or take away. No English evidence found.

osaka_ramen_yamafuji_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen, tsukemen and mazesoba noodles.
osaka_ramen_yamafuji_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broths of pork bone, chicken carcass, niboshi and kombu, with chashu.
osaka_ramen_yamafuji_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Mon and Wed 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:50); Tue, Thu and Fri 11:30–21:00 (last order 20:45); Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last order 15:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog); a ticket machine that takes new notes (August 2025). 12 seats: 8 at the counter and 2 tables (May 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Lunch price ¥950 on weekdays; rice ¥50 or ¥100 extra, self-service and refillable (2025–2026). Opened here 20 December 2019 (Tabelog); a May 2026 diner remembers the shop before it moved.
osaka_ramen_yamafuji_shin_osaka.notes: [Ramen · Nishimiyahara, a ramen made for rice] A 12-seat ramen shop hidden at the back of an apartment building's entrance west of Shin-Osaka, here since 2019, whose idea is ramen that goes with rice. The Yamafuji ramen (¥950) is a pork-bone and seafood shoyu of pork, chicken, niboshi and kombu, with thin or curly noodles, and the rice is self-service and refillable for ¥50–100, with a tsukudani made from the broth's own kombu and a niboshi furikake to pile on (2025–2026). The other house bowl is a slightly sweet white miso ramen with yuzu; there are tsukemen and a mazesoba too. One regular has been back ten times (March 2026); lunch can mean a short wait outside. Cash only; closed Sunday, and only Tuesday, Thursday and Friday run into the evening.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened at this address 20 December 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers: the shop moved here from an earlier site (May and September 2026); its concept is ramen that goes with rice (February 2026); "the rice policy differs between this location and the main store" (November 2025); friendly staff (April 2026). The osaka-kita crawl also lists らーめんやまふじ スープ工房東三国店.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ramen that goes well with rice (a February 2026 review, on "the restaurant's concept").
chef_bio.specialty: Yamafuji ramen with refillable rice; white miso ramen.

anecdotes.text: "I topped it with a tsukudani made from the kombu used for the ramen broth and some niboshi (dried sardine) furikake." — March 2026, a diner on visit ten, the Yamafuji ramen for JPY 950.
"The white miso soup, which has a slightly sweet seafood base with a hint of yuzu, pairs perfectly with the curly noodles." — April 2026, JPY 1,000 on a Saturday.
"The restaurant is located in a somewhat hidden spot at the back of the first floor entrance of the apartment building, so be cautious." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らーめん やまふじ 新大阪本店、ラーメン・つけ麺・油そば・まぜそば、大阪市淀川区西宮原2-6-16 新大阪コーポビアネーズ 1F、三国駅から712m、月・水11:30〜16:00、火・木・金11:30〜21:00、土・祝11:30〜15:00、日曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、12席、禁煙、2019年12月20日オープン。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年9月): マンションの入口の奥でわかりにくい、カウンター8席とテーブル2つ、券売機、Yamafuji Ramen 950円、豚骨、鶏ガラ、煮干し、昆布の魚介豚骨醤油、油は軽め、細いストレート麺か中太のちぢれ麺、たけのこ、白味噌のラーメン (少し甘く柚子の香り) 950円〜1,000円、特製はチャーシュー2種、卵、メンマ、辛いペースト、柑橘の皮、Ichikara ラーメン980円、魚介のつけ麺、まぜそば、ごはんはセルフでおかわり自由50〜100円、スープの昆布の佃煮と煮干しのふりかけ、まかない丼、移転前の店を知る人も、ごはんに合うラーメンがコンセプト。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine (cash only); say thin or curly noodles when handing over the ticket. No English evidence found.

osaka_katsu_bei_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet in every bowl.
osaka_katsu_bei_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlet with egg simmered in dashi.
osaka_katsu_bei_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00; Thu–Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday; hours may change. Reviewers find it shorter in the evening: an October 2026 diner says it closes at 19:00 even on weekdays, and at 18:30 one April 2026 evening it was already closing; it sometimes opens before 11:00 (August and September 2026), and once showed "Closed for Preparation" at 13:20 (October 2026). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog); order at the ticket machine (2026). 12 counter seats on Tabelog, 10–11 per reviewers; non-smoking (Tabelog). Lines at lunch; come at opening.
osaka_katsu_bei_higashimikuni.notes: [Katsu-don · Higashimikuni, one cook and a ¥900 bowl] A one-man katsu-don counter in the old shopping street by Higashimikuni Station, with a line at most lunches and Southern All Stars on the stereo. The owner fries each thick pork-loin cutlet to order, slices it into eight and lays it on rice under egg simmered in dashi, so it stays crisp under the egg; ¥900 with red miso soup, or ¥970 with curry (October 2026). Oroshi with grated daikon and a sauce katsu-don on cabbage are the alternatives, and double katsu or double egg is a few hundred yen more for big appetites. A card on the counter explains, with evident love, what is special about the pork (October 2026). Get there at opening; evenings end early, around 19:00 per reviewers, and Thursday to Saturday is lunch only.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: "The restaurant is run solely by the owner, with just counter seating available" (November 2024); "it's a one-person operation" (September 2026); "The owner's passion for Katsu Don shines through" (October 2026); a table card titled "What's Amazing Here!" explains the pork (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Katsu-don; oroshi, sauce and curry katsu-don.

anecdotes.text: "The friendly chef was working solo but was very efficient." — October 2026, the katsu-don for JPY 900.
"Sitting at the counter, the sounds of frying katsu and the crisp slicing of the meat are quite pleasant!" — October 2026, the curry katsu-don.
"You get the flavor absorption of stewed Katsu without losing the crispiness, capturing the best of both worlds." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かつ兵衛、カツ丼、大阪市淀川区東三国4-17-7、東三国駅から201m、月〜水11:00〜14:00、17:00〜21:00、木〜土11:00〜14:00、日曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、12席 (カウンター)、禁煙。口コミ(2024年11月〜2026年10月): 店主がひとりで切り盛り、カウンター10〜11席、券売機、昼は行列、カツ丼900円、おろしカツ丼900円、ソースカツ丼900円、カレーカツ丼970円、赤だしつき、ごはん大盛り50円、卵ダブル50円、カツダブル450円、厚いロースのカツを注文ごとに揚げて8切れ、だしで煮た卵をかける、ソースカツ丼はキャベツと温泉卵、テーブルに豚の説明「What's Amazing Here!」、たくあん、Southern All Stars の音楽、夜は19時までという声も、11時前に開くことも。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine (cash only) with four bowls and add-ons. No English evidence found.

osaka_bistro_olympic_uranamba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The carpaccio of five fish with four sauces, ajillo, a bluefin-cheek steak and fried potatoes sit beside pastas, fried pizza and baguette; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_bistro_olympic_uranamba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-led Italian bar; the soup of the day served as the appetizer has been a white-fish soup (September 2026) and most plates are fish, meat or cheese.
osaka_bistro_olympic_uranamba.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri–Sun 12:00–24:00; Wed–Thu 17:00–24:00; last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30; one irregular closing day a month; lunch service may close irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Reservations; tables may be shared at a large table, two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). A cover charge (お通し) applies; a soup of the day comes as the appetizer (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 41 seats at a counter, tables and an open terrace; the doors are thrown open in fine weather (October 2026); a 4th-floor event space, tide pool, for up to 45; non-smoking; children of school age welcome (official site; Tabelog). Opened 22 December 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_bistro_olympic_uranamba.notes: [Italian · Ura Namba, a noon-to-midnight seafood bistro] A casual, open-fronted Italian bar in Ura Namba, with a counter, tables and a terrace, serving straight through from noon to midnight (from 17:00 on Wednesdays and Thursdays). Reviewers place it in the Hidezo group of fish restaurants, and the fish shows: the dish nearly everyone orders is a carpaccio of five kinds of raw fish with four sauces to mix. Then ajillo, a bluefin-cheek steak, shrimp mayo or a pasta of yam and dashi, with a natural-wine list that runs to orange and rosé. A soup of the day comes as the appetizer. Busy most evenings and fully booked by 18:00 on a Sunday in October 2026, though walk-ins often get in; with the doors open, small insects can find their way in (October 2026). A 4th-floor space hosts parties of up to 45.

roles: Chef (unnamed; "シェフがこだわり抜いた一皿" on the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a casual, popular-style Italian bar in Ura Namba, open from noon to midnight, with natural wines and a 4th-floor party space; sister shops listed on the site are bar pond, 立ち飲みピラフ, お料理 だいち, tide pool, Meguri Osaka and ぱどる. Several 2026 reviewers say it belongs to the "Hidezo" (also written "Hidezou") group, and one regular of the neighbouring Hidezo says that shop is next door (October 2026). Opened 22 December 2017 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Casual and authentic at once: photogenic plates for day drinking, dates and parties, any time from noon to midnight (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Carpaccio of five fish with four sauces; natural wine.

anecdotes.text: "The moment the 'Assorted Carpaccio of 5 Types' arrived, my excitement skyrocketed! You absolutely have to order this dish when you visit!" — October 2026.
"I often visit the neighboring Hidezou, but this was my first time here." — October 2026, fully booked by 6 PM on a Sunday.
"While the open air was nice, it did attract some small bugs, which was a bit unpleasant..." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (bistro-olympic.com): ビストロolympic、大阪・ウラなんばにある大衆イタリアン酒場、昼飲みや女子会、デートに、12:00〜24:00 (水・木は17:00〜24:00、L.O. 料理23:00・ドリンク23:30)、定休日は月1回 (不定期)、ナチュールワイン (白・赤・ロゼ・オレンジ)、テラス席、テーブル席、カウンター、4階に最大45名の団体スペース、難波千日前4-19、南海難波駅より徒歩4分、姉妹店: bar pond、立ち飲みピラフ、お料理 だいち、tide pool、Meguri Osaka、ぱどる。食べログ (店舗会員): ビストロ・イタリアン・居酒屋、お通しあり、混雑時は2時間制、相席の大テーブルの場合あり、41席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、2017年12月22日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 5種のカルパッチョと4種のソース、お通しのスープ、アヒージョ、本まぐろのほほ肉のステーキ、山芋と出汁のパスタ、日曜の夕方は予約で満席、扉を開け放つと小さな虫も、Hidezo のグループの店という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or table; walk-ins often seated. No English evidence found.

osaka_kobe_gyu_sukiyaki_gyujin_shinsaiba.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The sukiyaki is seasoned with sugar and soy sauce (official site) and the sets end with udon; shabu-shabu is also offered, but its sauces are not described.
osaka_kobe_gyu_sukiyaki_gyujin_shinsaiba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kobe beef and wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu courses, with raw egg for dipping.
osaka_kobe_gyu_sukiyaki_gyujin_shinsaiba.hours_raw: Daily except Thursday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); holiday periods may differ (official site; Tabelog). Reservations online in Japanese, English or Traditional Chinese (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, iD, QUICPay, nanaco, WAON, and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (official site; Tabelog). 46 seats, all in private rooms for 4, 6 or 8; non-smoking; no parking; children welcome (official site; Tabelog). English and Traditional Chinese menus; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 23 May 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_kobe_gyu_sukiyaki_gyujin_shinsaiba.notes: [Sukiyaki · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Kobe beef in private rooms] On the 8th floor of a Higashi-Shinsaibashi building, a sukiyaki house of private rooms decorated with ukiyo-e and ink paintings, opened in May 2025 by the beef-focused restaurant company Dancin' Diner. The style is Kansai sukiyaki: the meat seared in a square iron pan and seasoned with sugar and soy sauce, the first slice cooked in front of you by the staff. Kobe beef is the headline, but most 2026 diners ordered the ¥5,800 domestic-beef set booked online, which comes with udon to finish and a homemade dessert, and enjoyed comparing two dipping eggs. One noted the domestic beef was less marbled than Kobe beef. English menus and English-speaking staff; the room is aimed at overseas visitors as much as business dinners. Closed Thursdays.

roles: Run by 株式会社ダンシンダイナー (Dancin' Diner), a beef-focused restaurant company (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the brand page on d-diner.net: a Kobe beef and wagyu sukiyaki house drawing on long experience supplying high-quality beef, aiming to "lead the way" in bringing wagyu to the world; Kansai-style "grilled" sukiyaki in square iron pans; top-grade Kobe beef as the main; every seat in a private room decorated with ukiyo-e and ink painting, suited to sightseeing, business entertaining and overseas guests. The company runs yakiniku, shabu-shabu and teppanyaki brands in Kansai and Kanto (d-diner.net brand list); this is its only 牛陣. Opened 23 May 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: An unforgettable wagyu experience that blends Japanese culture with Kansai sukiyaki (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kansai-style Kobe beef sukiyaki; two-egg tasting.

anecdotes.text: "You can choose between two types of eggs: 'Dragon's Egg' and 'Kyoto Egg,' both of which are available for unlimited refills." — September 2026, the ¥5,800 set.
"Compared to Kobe beef and black-haired Wagyu loin, the marbling and melt-in-your-mouth texture were more subtle, but it was tender and delicious." — October 2026.
"The clientele includes many Japanese customers, and recently, there has been an increase in foreign visitors" — October 2026, Halloween decorations in the rooms.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ダンシンダイナー公式サイト (d-diner.net): 神戸牛すき焼き 牛陣 心斎橋店、日本文化と関西風すき焼きが融合した究極の和牛体験、和牛の魅力を「先陣を切って世界へお届けする」神戸牛・和牛専門のすき焼き店、鉄鍋で焼き上げ砂糖と醤油で味付けする“焼く”スタイルの関西風すき焼き、最高ランクの神戸牛、最初の一枚をキャストが目の前で焼き上げる、しゃぶしゃぶ、サーロインステーキ付きのコース、全席個室、浮世絵や水墨画、海外からのお客様のおもてなしにも、東心斎橋2-4-30 グランドジャニスビル 8F、長堀橋駅徒歩4分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、木曜定休、全46席 (4名個室3、6名個室3、8名個室2)、カード・電子マネー・コード決済可、英語と繁體中文の予約。ブランド一覧: 焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ・鉄板焼など牛肉中心の業態を関西・関東で展開。食べログ (店舗会員): すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、英語・繁体字メニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、禁煙、子ども可、2025年5月23日オープン。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 国産牛すき焼きかしゃぶしゃぶのセット5,800円 (ロース140g、野菜、締めのうどん、デザート)、コースは5,800〜32,800円、2種類の卵の食べ比べ、Aomori のリブロース、海外からの客も増えている。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Traditional Chinese menus and online booking; English-speaking staff (official site; Tabelog).

existence.note: Brand page on d-diner.net (notice dated July 2026) and the shop-maintained Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_udon_hanakiri_minamihorie.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat-udon house; the sides are tempura, kakiage, kara-age and kushiage, and the broths are dashi and soy-based.
osaka_udon_hanakiri_minamihorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the udon broth is dashi-based and most toppings are chicken, beef, fish cake or tempura.
osaka_udon_hanakiri_minamihorie.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:45 (last order 15:15) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed over the New Year only (Tabelog). Lunch sets until 14:00 (October 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Order on a tablet (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). 83 seats: 13 at the counter, tables and 32 on tatami with sunken seating; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Opened 1 May 2021 per Tabelog (an older note on the listing gives June, after the state of emergency).
osaka_udon_hanakiri_minamihorie.notes: [Udon · Minami-Horie, a big, generous Sanuki-style udon house] Much larger inside than the shopfront suggests, with a counter for solo diners, tables and tatami with sunken seating, this Minami-Horie udon house fills with families, couples, tourists and office workers at weekend lunch. The noodles are firm, chewy Sanuki-style, and you can take up to one and a half servings at no extra cost. Favourites include kakiage udon with two big fritters, a sudachi udon to which you add soy sauce, curry udon with chicken tempura or beef tendon, and duck-and-chicken paitan udon; lunch sets (until 14:00) add a bowl of rice such as takikomi or mentaiko. Evenings bring kushiage, oden and sake. Order on a tablet; food comes fast. Diners differ on the curry, which some found thin. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; opened 1 May 2021, with an older remark on the listing that it would open in June after the state of emergency. No official site or branch was found. A September 2026 diner compared the bukkake udon to that of the closed Hagakure.
chef_bio.specialty: Kakiage udon; sudachi udon; curry udon.

osaka_itameshiya_sugu_kitashinchi.notes: [Italian · Kitashinchi, a late-night Italian counter] A small, tiled-counter Italian restaurant in Kitashinchi, open since 2024 at lunch and then from 18:00 until 5:00 on weekdays, with the motto "affordable and delicious". The pasta lunch is the bargain: from ¥1,500 you get a bagna cauda of roasted vegetables, a plate of starters that may include oysters or roast duck, and one of three daily pastas, sometimes homemade tagliatelle (2026). At night the counter fills with wine drinkers over prosciutto with burrata and strawberries, oysters in garlic oil, fried yam with truffle and Quattro Formaggi, or courses from ¥3,980. One person cooks at lunch, so expect a short wait; one diner found it hard to get water on a busy night (September 2026). A 10% late-night charge applies after 22:00, and smoking is allowed in the evening.

osaka_iaku_kitashinchi.notes: [Innovative · Kitashinchi, an eight-seat cross-genre counter] An eight-seat counter on a sixth floor in Kitashinchi, opened in 2022 and named a Tabelog French WEST 100 in 2025, where one course mixes French, Italian and Japanese technique around big, rich ingredients; a September 2026 diner says it is produced by Yuka Hattori of U.KAI. Everyone starts together, after the cook shows the day's cuts of wagyu, matsutake and lobster. The course opens with its signature, a Kagoshima wagyu fillet katsu sandwich, then caviar tartare on brioche, a sea-urchin chawanmushi, cold noodles with hamo, fish in saffron sauce, truffled fillet steak and a clay-pot rice of lobster and matsutake (autumn 2026). Diners call the portions generous. Lunch is ¥13,200 and dinner ¥23,100, the dinner price including service; give allergies when booking, not on the day.

osaka_takoyaki_sakaba_n_kitashinchi.notes: [Takoyaki · Kitashinchi, a takoyaki bar in an old snack bar] A small takoyaki and teppan bar up a flight of stairs in a Kitashinchi building, opened in October 2023 in what still looks like a retro snack bar, with sofa seats and takoyaki-shaped decor. Takoyaki made with a rich dashi come in several kinds, with salt among them and limited-time versions, alongside okonomiyaki, akashiyaki and teppan plates of beef tongue, seafood and vegetables, ending with garlic rice, and there is a cheap list of Japanese whisky. osaka_naniwa_tempura_ishin_kitashinchi.notes: [Tempura · Kitashinchi, tempura and champagne] A tempura counter on a third floor down a narrow Kitashinchi lane, opened in 2016 and on Tabelog's Tempura 100 lists for 2022 and 2023, built on pairing tempura with champagne chosen by its sommelier. Seasonal seafood and vegetables, Osaka produce included, are fried in cottonseed oil; in spring and summer the chef shows you live young sweetfish before frying them. The finish everyone talks about is tamago-kake-gohan with truffle shaved over it at the counter, or with sea urchin. Courses run ¥8,000 at lunch to ¥15,000, with a 5% service charge at dinner only. One regular on a 31st visit singled out a foie gras wrapped in beef and fried (September 2026). There are also sunken-kotatsu private rooms.

chef_bio.chef_name: 畑島 亮 (named on the official site; romaji not given)
roles: Name signed under the official site's greeting (role not stated)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (ishin-ryo.com, read 2026-11-02): なにわ天ぷら 維心, champagne chosen by a sommelier to go with the world of Ishin; TV features in 2018 (モモコのOH！ソレ！み〜よ！, おはよう朝日です, よ〜いドン！). Per Tabelog: tempura of seasonal vegetables and seafood fried in rare cottonseed oil, Osaka ingredients, signature truffle tamago-kake-gohan, 10th anniversary, Tabelog Tempura 100 2022 and 2023; opened 10 November 2016.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A new combination" of Osaka-sourced tempura and champagne (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Truffle tamago-kake-gohan; tempura with champagne.

anecdotes.text: "The truffle egg over rice served at the end is always exceptional... I even want to pick up the truffles that fall outside the bowl when they are shaved." — February 2026.
"To finish, we had the truffle egg over rice and the sea urchin egg over rice." — April 2026, the seasonal omakase; live young sweetfish were shown before frying.
"The foie gras is first sautéed to a certain degree, then wrapped in beef and deep-fried at a high temperature." — September 2026, a 30th visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: なにわ天ぷら 維心、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-3-36 竹新ビル3階、ランチ12:00〜14:00 (前日までの予約)、ディナー18:00〜22:30、日・祝休み、ソムリエ厳選のシャンパンとともに維心の世界観を、畑島 亮、テレビ放映歴 (2018年: モモコのOH！ソレ！み〜よ！、おはよう朝日です、よ〜いドン！)。食べログ (店舗会員): 天ぷら、北新地駅から徒歩2分、北新地の本通りと上通りのあいだの細い道、花屋の近く、月18:00〜22:30、火〜土12:00〜14:00、日・祝休み、ディナーは2名から18時より、当日17時まではネット予約、それ以降は電話、当日キャンセルは全額、ディナーのみサービス料5%、ランチはコースのみ2日前までに予約、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、13席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつの個室)、禁煙、ソムリエ、2016年11月10日オープン、10周年、希少な綿実油で揚げる、名物はトリュフの卵かけごはん、ウニの卵かけごはん、シャンパンと天ぷらのペアリング、大阪の食材、食べログ 天ぷら 百名店 2022・2023、天ぷらショートコース8,000円、季節のおまかせ12,000円、上質な食材のコース15,000円。口コミ(2026年1月〜10月): 生きた稚鮎を見せてから揚げる、山菜、アスパラ、とうもろこし、甘エビ、牛で包んだフォアグラの天ぷら、トリュフの卵かけごはん、ウニの卵かけごはん、ミニ天丼、ソムリエおすすめのシャンパン、掘りごたつの個室、31回通う常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter tempura courses with a sommelier; book ahead for lunch (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

osaka_acchichi_honpo_dotonbori.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: takoyaki is a wheat batter, with sauce and soy-sauce toppings; no gluten-free option described.
osaka_acchichi_honpo_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki in a dashi batter, topped with bonito flakes.
osaka_acchichi_honpo_dotonbori.hours_raw: Sun–Fri and holidays 9:00–2:00; Sat and the day before a holiday 9:00–3:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted but seats not guaranteed; reservations get priority (Tabelog). Queues at peak times: about 15 minutes in October 2026, a long line at 17:00 in September 2026. Buy a ticket at the register and hand it over; self-service eat-in (August–September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 40 seats: a counter of 12 and tables, plus 12 terrace seats on the riverside walk, and a cool eat-in floor below street level (Tabelog; September 2026); non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_acchichi_honpo_dotonbori.notes: [Takoyaki · Dotonbori riverside, until 2 or 3 a.m.] A takoyaki counter on the Dotonbori river walk, east of the Ebisubashi bridge and its Glico sign, that cooks on cast iron rather than copper so the balls come out with a thin crisp shell and a molten centre around a piece of fresh, never-frozen octopus. Order the soy-sauce mayo with green onion (the house favourite) or the classic sauce and mayo; 8 for ¥800, or ¥1,200 with a beer (October 2026). Buy a ticket at the register; eat on the riverside terrace, at the counter or in the cool room below. Expect a short queue in the evening; cash only; open from 9:00 to 2:00 or 3:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: three commitments, to the cast-iron plate (harder to use than copper), to fresh octopus from the central market, never frozen, and to the dashi and a sauce made in the company's factory in Higashi-Osaka. A September 2026 diner first found it some 20 years earlier as a lesser-known stand and has since seen it gain long queues.
chef_bio.philosophy: Commitment to the iron plate, the octopus, and the dashi and sauce (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Soy-sauce mayo takoyaki with green onion; cast-iron takoyaki.

anecdotes.text: "As a local, I was curious about the fact that these takoyaki are cooked on an old-fashioned teppan rather than copper … the outside was well-cooked, though not exactly crispy, while the inside remained wonderfully gooey." — October 2026.
"About 20 years ago … I discovered Acchichi Honpo and bought their takoyaki. I still can't forget the taste of their salt-flavored takoyaki." — September 2026.
"What I appreciated the most was that there were air-conditioned eat-in seats available on the basement floor." — September 2026, after a long line at 5 PM.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): あっちち本舗 道頓堀店、たこ焼き・居酒屋・お好み焼き、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-19、日本橋駅から徒歩10分、日〜金・祝9:00〜翌2:00、土・祝前日9:00〜翌3:00、予約可 (席の確保は保証できない、予約の人を優先)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、40席 (カウンター12、テーブル28、テラス12)、禁煙、子ども可、戎橋のGlico の看板から東へ、橋のたもとの一蘭のところ、こだわり: 銅板ではなく技術のいる鉄板で焼き、外は薄くカリッと中はとろり、中央市場の生のタコで冷凍しない、出汁とHigashi-Osakaの自社工場で作るソース、一番人気はねぎ無料の醤油マヨ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 8個800円、9個だったという口コミも、ソースマヨ、塩、ポン酢、たこ焼きと飲み物のセット1,200円、レジで食券、セルフサービス、地下に涼しいイートイン、未就学児はソフトドリンク無料、夕方は行列、現金のみ、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy a ticket at the register and serve yourself; many overseas customers (October 2026). No English menu evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_wagyu_ryori_kaname_minamikyuhoji.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The motsunabe comes in soy, miso or salt broth and finishes with ramen; the lunch has hamburg steak, beef katsu and menchi katsu; the stone-grilled wagyu is eaten with sesame and salt, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_wagyu_ryori_kaname_minamikyuhoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu stone grill, horumon and motsunabe; kimchi and vegetables are the only plant dishes mentioned.
osaka_wagyu_ryori_kaname_minamikyuhoji.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30); Mon–Sat dinner 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday and holidays, Golden Week, Obon and New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, recommended at lunch, when a few groups wait for the 11:30 opening (Tabelog; September 2026). Ordering by tablet (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 150 seats in renovated Showa-era row houses, with fully private rooms for 2 to over 30, tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
osaka_wagyu_ryori_kaname_minamikyuhoji.notes: [Wagyu · Minamikyuhojimachi, a Showa row-house complex] A wagyu restaurant set in renovated Showa-era row houses between Shinsaibashi and Honmachi, where you are led through the lanes to tatami or sunken private rooms. Dinner is the stone grill of A5 black wagyu, which you cook yourself and eat wrapped in green onion with sesame and salt, followed by a motsunabe in soy, miso or salt and ramen to finish; the "Mahoroba" course of both is ¥4,730 (with a drinks option). Lunch is hamburg, beef katsu or the five-a-day Kaname Gozen (¥2,000 in October 2026). Popular for business dinners; book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a renovated Showa-era townhouse; A5 female black wagyu and the best meat available at the time; wines and local sake; fully private rooms for business meetings and anniversaries. A September 2026 diner was led through a passage to a separate building beside a private house.
chef_bio.specialty: A5 wagyu stone grill; motsunabe.

anecdotes.text: "Limited to just 5 servings of this elusive bento. … featuring a generous 70g of Kuroge Wagyu steak" — October 2026, the Kaname Gozen for JPY 2,000.
"I enjoyed wrapping it in green onions and savoring it with sesame and salt, which allowed me to fully appreciate the flavor of the meat." — September 2026.

"Entering this extraordinary space, which feels like it's in the middle of Honmachi and Shinsaibashi, I was guided to a private room in a traditional Japanese house." — October 2026, the yakiniku course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 和牛料理 要、牛料理・もつ鍋・ステーキ、大阪市中央区南久宝寺町4-3-1、心斎橋駅3番出口から徒歩5分、本町駅15番出口から徒歩5分、月〜金11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、月〜土17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、日曜・祝日休み、GW・お盆・年末年始休み、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、150席、完全個室 (2名から30名以上)、座敷、掘りごたつ、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、昭和の町家を改装、A5の黒毛和牛の雌の石焼き、もつ鍋、Mahoroba コース (黒毛和牛の石焼きステーキ70gともつ鍋) 4,730円、120分飲み放題つきも。口コミ(2024年3月〜2026年10月): 醤油・味噌・塩のもつ鍋、季節のしじみもつ鍋、締めのラーメン、石焼きの和牛をねぎで巻いてごま塩で、土鍋ご飯、とうもろこしご飯、Tsurumi-bashi のキムチ、石焼ビビンバ、ランチの Kaname Gozen 2,000円は1日5食、ハンバーグ定食1,320円、牛カツ、メンチカツ、タブレットで注文、商談に人気。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses booked online; order by tablet; you grill the stone-grilled wagyu yourself (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_una_shige_bakuromachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Kabayaki and the eel bowls are glazed in a soy-based tare; the premium kabayaki can be ordered white-grilled (shirayaki) without tare (official menu), but nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_una_shige_bakuromachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant; even the rolled omelette and the soup contain eel.
osaka_una_shige_bakuromachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–22:00; Sat 11:00–21:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Tabelog says no reservations, though a July 2026 diner phoned ahead on the Day of the Ox; full at lunch at weekends (August 2026). Bento and take-out of bowls, sets and dishes, sold outside the door at busy times (official site; July 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay and Rakuten Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats: a counter, tables and a tatami room; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Moved from 博労町2-2-4 in August 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_una_shige_bakuromachi.notes: [Unagi · Bakuromachi, Kansai-style eel at a fair price] A plain eel house in Bakuromachi, sister to the fugu restaurant ふぐ茂, that grills its eel the Kansai way, without steaming, turning it until the skin crisps. The Una Shige set (¥2,160) is the one regulars order every month: an eel bowl with an eel omelette the size of an inkstone box, uzaku and a rich liver soup; the ¥3,530 set adds kabayaki. Open all afternoon on weekdays, so it is easy outside the lunch rush, and the bowls and bento are sold to take away. One September 2026 diner waited over 20 minutes while the owner was on the phone; most 2026 visitors found it generous and good value. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site of ふぐ茂: うな茂 is the sister eel shop of the fugu and hamo restaurant ふぐ茂, grilling carefully chosen eel Kansai-style without steaming. It moved to its current address in August 2009 (Tabelog). A September 2026 diner waited over 20 minutes for an order while the owner talked on the phone at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Una Shige set; eel omelette (umaki).

anecdotes.text: "It was huge—almost the size of a suzuribako (inkstone)! The fluffy egg was packed with eel" — September 2026, the Una Shige set for JPY 2,160.
"I come here every month!" — October 2026, a fifth visit, the Una Shige set with its rich liver soup.
"They kindly served the grilled eel liver as an appetizer before the set meal arrived." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ふぐ茂の姉妹店): うなぎ料理専門店「うな茂」、大きさと鮮度を厳選したうなぎを蒸さずに焼く関西風、何度も返して焼き上げた香ばしさと中のやわらかさ、蒲焼定食5,220円、うなぎ定食3,530円、うな茂定食2,160円、鰻丼 松3,960円・竹2,810円・梅1,820円、上蒲焼3,240円 (白焼可)、並蒲焼2,120円、八幡巻1,690円、鯉の洗い830円、肝煮770円、骨唐揚410円、うざく1,410円、肝焼き830円、う巻770円、うまき弁当2,810円、税込、持ち帰り可、冬は鍋 (予約のみ)、ビール550円。食べログ: 大阪市中央区博労町2-3-11、月〜金11:00〜22:00、土11:00〜21:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約不可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay・楽天ペイ可、40席、カウンターと座敷、禁煙、2009年8月に博労町2-2-4から移転。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 硯箱ほどの大きなう巻、肝吸い、土用の丑の日は電話で確認、店の外で弁当、量が多くお得、オーナーの電話で20分以上待ったという口コミも。

cultural_comfort.note: A short menu of eel sets and bowls; easy for solo diners (August 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_sakanaya_hidezou_bekkan_sennichima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is the core of the menu, but there are simmered fish, fried fugu, tempura and kara-age, and soy and ponzu throughout; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_sakanaya_hidezou_bekkan_sennichima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; Manganji peppers, water eggplant and corn tempura are among the few plant dishes mentioned.
osaka_sakanaya_hidezou_bekkan_sennichima.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sat 17:00–23:00; Sun 15:00–23:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and often needed at peak times, though same-day calls and early walk-ins have found seats (2026 reviews); 2.5-hour limit (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; no service charge (Tabelog). 70 seats over several floors, counter and tables, no private rooms; a fourth-floor bar (Tabelog; 2026 reviews); non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_sakanaya_hidezou_bekkan_sennichima.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Ura-Namba, the fishmonger's annex] The sit-down annex of 魚屋ひでぞう, the hard-to-book fishmonger's izakaya in Namba, round the corner in Ura-Namba, with seats over several floors. The fish comes from the company's own market business, so start with the sashimi platter (five or seven kinds), then simmered kinmedai, a grilled collar, oysters with ponzu or fried fugu, and the clam-dashi chazuke to finish. Prices are moderate: about ¥3,000–6,000 a head in 2026. Book, or try a same-day call or an early arrival at 17:00; stays are 2.5 hours. Closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: Hidezou is a fish shop with rights to trade at the Eastern Market, supplying fresh seafood to over 100 restaurants and fish shops; the annex opened in Ura-Namba for people who cannot get a booking at Hidezo Namba. An August 2026 diner notes Hidezou has many branches; an October 2026 diner found its standing bar closed twice and came here instead.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platters; clam-dashi chazuke.

anecdotes.text: "I hadn't made a reservation in advance, but on a whim, I called in the evening on the same day and was lucky enough to get a table." — October 2026, a fourth visit.
"The clam dashi chazuke had an amazing broth that made me want to have it again" — September 2026, a five-kind sashimi platter on the third floor.
"Some items took so long to serve that I wondered if they had been forgotten." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 魚屋ひでぞう 別館、魚介料理・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区難波千日前4-19 2F、南海なんば駅から徒歩4分、月・水〜土17:00〜23:00、日15:00〜23:00、火曜休み、予約可、2時間半制、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料なし、70席、個室なし、禁煙、Eastern Market の売買参加権を持つ魚屋で100以上の飲食店や魚屋に卸す、予約の取りにくい魚屋ひでぞう なんばの別館、4階はバー、飲み放題つきのコース。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 刺身の盛り合わせ5種と7種、炙りサワラ、本マグロ、キンメダイの煮付け、カンパチのカマ焼き、サンマ、生牡蠣、牡蠣ポン酢、タコポン酢、ふぐのkara-age、アナゴの揚げ物、とうもろこしの天ぷら、kara-age、マグロのシーザーサラダ、クリームチーズ、万願寺とうがらし、水なす、あさり出汁の茶漬け、Sapporo Lager Akaboshi、2階と3階の席、当日の電話や早い時間なら入れることも、料理が遅い日も、ひとり3,000〜6,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: A long à la carte list of fish dishes; book ahead at peak times (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_niru_to_kome_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Oden and clay-pot rice are cooked in a broth of chicken stock, bonito-kelp dashi, tomato and shiitake; lunches include fried horse mackerel and fried oysters.
osaka_niru_to_kome_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden broth is chicken stock and bonito dashi, and the signature is a chicken-and-egg rice bowl.
osaka_niru_to_kome_kitahorie.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); occasional closures for training, posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; say if you bring a pet, with its size and number (Tabelog). Starter ¥418 at dinner, none at lunch (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and other e-money, and QR payments including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 23 seats: a 6-seat counter, six tables for 2 and one for 5; private hire up to 30; non-smoking (Tabelog). Small dogs and other pets welcome inside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Children welcome, and food for children under school age may be brought in (Tabelog). Menus in English, simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog). Opened 5 December 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_niru_to_kome_kitahorie.notes: [Izakaya · Kitahorie, oden and clay-pot rice with your dog] A small second-floor izakaya in Kitahorie that welcomes dogs at the table, done up like a café with dried flowers, driftwood and a tiled counter. The cooking is oden in a broth of chicken stock, bonito-kelp dashi and tomato, and rice cooked to order in a clay pot; the dish to save room for is the oyakodon 'you must eat before you die', creamy egg over the pot rice, in salt or soy (¥2,398 in September 2026). Drinks are a bargain: draft beer ¥219, a mega mug ¥329, and salt chicken wings are ¥49 each. Lunch sets like fried horse mackerel and oysters run about ¥1,200. Diners in 2026 loved the staff, who even played 'wait' games with one guest's dog. English, Chinese and Korean menus.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a dog-friendly izakaya of clay-pot rice from carefully selected rice from professional growers, oden in a broth made in-house from chicken stock, bonito and kelp, tomatoes and shiitake, and very cheap drinks; opened 5 December 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot oyakodon; oden.

anecdotes.text: "The first dish served was a cute monaka (wafer) shaped like a dog, sitting adorably." — September 2026.
"I was also surprised by the 'Umashio Teba (Delicious Salt Chicken Wings).' At just JPY 49 each, they were incredibly affordable" — September 2026.
"I even got to try the 'wait' challenge." — September 2026, dinner with a dog.

osaka_panyu_zakkoku_shokufu_shimanouchi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the signature biang biang noodles are wide wheat noodles, alongside dumplings, spring rolls and soy-based sauces.
osaka_panyu_zakkoku_shokufu_shimanouchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: lamb skewers, fish, pork and chicken in Xi'an and Sichuan dishes.
osaka_panyu_zakkoku_shokufu_shimanouchi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–02:00 (food last order 01:30, drinks 02:00) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 33 seats at tables, private and semi-private rooms for 4 to 20; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Touch-panel ordering (August 2025). Menus in English, simplified Chinese and Korean with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog). Takeaway and delivery (Tabelog; January 2026).
osaka_panyu_zakkoku_shokufu_shimanouchi.notes: [Chinese · Shimanouchi, biang biang noodles until 2 a.m.] A Chinese tavern on Shimanouchi's street of Chinese and Korean restaurants, open from 11 a.m. to 2 a.m., built around Xi'an's biang biang noodles, a single long, wide, chewy noodle the shop calls the longest in Japan, served in a bowl about 50 cm across, spicy or mild. The owner is from Sichuan, so the rest of the menu runs to numbing, spicy dishes: poached white fish in chili, lamb skewers, hot-and-sour dumplings, and frogs and crayfish for the curious. Terracotta-warrior figures stand in the room. Diners who know China call it authentic; the spice is strong for some. Banquet courses with all-you-can-drink are ¥5,000–5,300, cheaper with a coupon. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Chinese tavern of Xi'an and Sichuan cooking; biang biang noodles "rumored to be the longest in Japan", made by skilled noodle chefs; spices and herbs from the owner's hometown in Sichuan; many TV and media features. An August 2025 diner noted the staff were from abroad but understood Japanese; an August 2026 diner noticed terracotta-warrior figures in the room.
chef_bio.specialty: Biang biang noodles; spicy poached fish.

anecdotes.text: "The Biang Biang noodles are quite substantial. The bowl is about 50 cm in diameter" — October 2026, a weekend afternoon.
"Each bowl of Biang Biang Noodles contains only one type of noodle! Haha. Some parts are as soft as wontons, while others are similar to udon!" — July 2026.
"... thrilled to see the Terracotta Warriors displayed here." — August 2026, a second visit with a parent who loves the history of Xi'an.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 朋友雑穀食府 (パンユウザッコクショクフ)、中華・飲茶・串焼き、大阪市中央区島之内2-6-16 第２右田ビル １Ｆ、長堀橋駅から徒歩6分、毎日11:00〜翌2:00 (料理L.O.1:30)、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、33席 (テーブル)、4〜20名の個室と半個室、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、英語と中国語のスタッフ、写真つきメニュー、テイクアウト。店の紹介 (英訳): 西安と四川の料理、焼き魚、串、鍋の中国居酒屋、日本一長いといわれる西安のbiang biang の麺、オーナーの故郷の四川の香辛料と薬味、麻と辣、テレビなどで紹介、飲み放題つき14品の宴会コース (月〜木5,000円、金〜日5,300円、クーポンで25%引き)。口コミ(2025年8月〜2026年10月): biang biang の麺 (辛いのと辛くないの)、トマトと卵の麺、直径50cmほどの器、白身魚の激辛煮、羊肉の串、春巻、酸辣湯の餃子、豚肉の炒め物のランチ、カエルとザリガニ、terracotta warrior の飾り、本場の味、香辛料が強い、飲み放題1,650円、デリバリーの配達員が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English- and Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog); touch-panel ordering.

osaka_sushi_nakago_bettei_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi with soy sauce, sesame-soy dressings and grilled dishes; a course included fried red-vinegar rice chips.
osaka_sushi_nakago_bettei_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi and fish dishes, with miso soup.
osaka_sushi_nakago_bettei_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:30); closed over New Year (Tabelog). The lunch sign gives last entry 14:00 (September 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Starter ¥330 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 34 seats with a counter, sofa and pair seats and private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Guests are asked not to wear strong perfume or fabric softener, and to take phone calls outside (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 7 November 2020 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_nakago_bettei_shinsaibashi.notes: [Sushi · Shinsaibashi, Japan Sea fish in a modern room] A sleek sushi bar of dark wood and metal three minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, part of the small Nakago group, serving red-vinegar sushi of fish from the Japan Sea around Kanazawa at prices meant for everyday use. Lunch is the deal: a ¥2,800 omakase of a small dish, the day's special, eight nigiri and red miso soup (October 2026). In the evening the autumn 'Shinogi' course (¥7,800) runs from isaki in sesame soy and two cuts of tuna to a butter-grilled oyster and an eel hand roll; sit at the counter to watch the chefs. Diners like the calm, date-worthy room; two in September–October 2026 felt rushed out at the end of a sitting. No strong perfume, please.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic sushi in a monochrome, modern Japanese designer space; concept "high-quality at an affordable price"; red-vinegar rice; fresh seafood from the Japan Sea centred on Kanazawa; sister shops Sushi Nakago Shinsaibashi and Meat Kaiseki Kissaki. Opened 7 November 2020. An October 2026 diner mentions a Nakago in Umeda.
chef_bio.philosophy: "High quality at an affordable price" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch omakase; Shinogi course.

anecdotes.text: "I chose the [Lunch Limited Omakase Course] for JPY 2,800. The course includes: Today's appetizer, Today's special dish, 8 pieces of nigiri, Soup" — October 2026.
"First up was Isaki (grunter) dressed in sesame soy sauce. Next, I savored two pieces of tuna nigiri." — October 2026, the Shinogi course ¥7,800.
"To maintain the ambiance, we were instructed to make phone calls outside." — September 2026.

osaka_tawanthai_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Rice-noodle and rice dishes are common in Thai cooking, but sauces (oyster, soy, fish sauce) are not described, and fried spring rolls and soft-shell crab are battered.
osaka_tawanthai_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: most dishes use fish sauce, chicken, pork or shrimp.
osaka_tawanthai_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Takeaway and Uber Eats until 21:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted for dinner indoors; none at lunch or for the terrace (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay and Rakuten Pay; coupons cannot be combined with PayPay (Tabelog; August 2026). 30 seats at tables, sofa seats and an open terrace; non-smoking, terrace included; children welcome, no children's chairs; no pets (Tabelog). Busy at weekday noon (September 2026). Opened 5 December 1999 (Tabelog).
osaka_tawanthai_minamisenba.notes: [Thai · Minami-Senba, a Thai kitchen since 1999] A long-running Thai restaurant on a Minami-Senba corner with an open terrace, busy with nearby office workers at weekday lunch. The menu is long and pictured, so first-timers can point: gapao rice, khao man gai, pad thai and the rarer pad see ew and pad kee mao, yellow curry with soft-shell crab, satay with peanut sauce, and a spicy tom yum noodle soup (¥1,050 at lunch in September 2026) that comes without coriander and with condiments to tune the heat. Lunch sets pair a curry or rice dish with soup. Regulars from nearby offices come back again and again; one solo diner found the minced-pork salad hot enough to sweat. Closed Sundays; no lunch bookings.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Thai cooking made easy to enjoy, a menu with photos and simple descriptions; opened 5 December 1999.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Authentic Thai cuisine that feels just like being in Thailand" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Pad thai; tom yum noodles; khao man gai.

anecdotes.text: "I tried the Tom Yum noodles for JPY 1050. The soup is really tasty. There's no cilantro included." — September 2026, lunch.
"I work nearby, and whenever I go out for lunch with friends, we always choose this place because it's delicious!" — September 2026.
"The soft-shell crab with yellow curry and the satay with peanut sauce were delicious!" — October 2026.

osaka_azuma_ke_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A Chinese menu of noodles, gyoza, fried rice and sauced stir-fries; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_azuma_ke_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese dishes with pork, chicken and seafood; even the vegetable gyoza and vegetable noodle soup are not described as meat-free.
osaka_azuma_ke_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:20–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch is busy with office workers but turns over quickly (2024–2026). Reservations accepted; cash only (Tabelog). 30 seats with a counter and a tatami room; whole hire possible (Tabelog). Second floor of the building (2020, 2024 reviews).
osaka_azuma_ke_nishinakajima.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the office workers' Chinese canteen] A 30-seat Chinese restaurant up one flight of stairs a block from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, packed with office workers at lunch on weekdays and quick to turn tables. The lunch sets are the reason: a main of the day, mapo tofu, curry fried rice or a bowl of hot and sour noodles, each with a mini ramen and rice for around ¥950–1,050 (2025–2026). Flavours run light, so regulars reach for the homemade chili oil on the table. Evenings bring thin-skinned vegetable and chive gyoza and fried rice with drinks. Cash only; closed weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: Chinese, ramen and tantanmen, 30 seats with a tatami room, cash only. Per reviews: "the restaurant is committed to using high-quality ingredients, avoiding chemical seasonings, and making [its] own sauces" (November 2020 review); "a favorite among office workers … it seems there are many repeat customers" (July 2024); "Even though it's a Chinese restaurant, [the shop] provided proper cloth napkins" (September 2025); "known for its speedy service" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with a mini ramen; hot and sour noodles.

anecdotes.text: "I absolutely love that the set comes with a small ramen. Sometimes, it also includes a small champon or other types of ramen." — July 2026, mapo tofu rice bowl set at spice level 3.
"The chives gyoza and vegetable gyoza were as their names suggest, with the vegetables taking center stage rather than the meat, resembling the thin-skinned Utsunomiya gyoza." — September 2025.
"The dishes at Azuma Ke are light, so I always feel refreshed after eating." — March 2026, vegetable tantanmen set.
