osaka_kou_chan_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in tonkotsu, miso or red-miso broth; fried rice, kara-age and gyoza on the side.
osaka_kou_chan_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth and pork chashu; a beef paitan ramen too.
osaka_kou_chan_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Sun, Mon, Wed and Thu 11:00–24:00; Fri and Sat 11:00–02:00; closed Tuesday (shop site; Tabelog agrees); open straight through the afternoon (October 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 28 seats at a counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Garlic is added on request (2026 reviews). Opened 13 September 2011 (Tabelog).
osaka_kou_chan_higashimikuni.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Mikuni, garlic ramen by the station until late] A 28-seat ramen shop right by the footbridge at Higashi-Mikuni Station, the station-side sister of a long-running local shop, open from 11:00 to midnight and until 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays. The base is a light tonkotsu with curly noodles, and the staff ask whether you want garlic: say yes for the full effect, or no for a punchy shoyu tonkotsu (2026). Regulars come back for the kimchi chashu ramen and the tsukemen's rich, salty dip, and red-miso, Kujo green-onion and spicy-miso bowls fill out a long menu. The chashu rice bowls and a mini curry are side-dish favourites. A late stop after drinks for many (2025–2026); PayPay, no cards.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (ninniku-kochan.com, read 2026-11-02): にんにくラーメン 幸ちゃん 東三国店 (reading given as ニンニクラーメン コウチャン ヒガシミクニテン); a light tonkotsu broth simmered for a long time, curly noodles, a range of miso including red miso, side dishes and courses, home-made grilled pork; open until 2:00; a sister shop linked on Tabelog. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: opened 13 September 2011. Per reviews: "I've been going to the main branch for about 30 years. This was my first time at the station-side location" (February 2026); "Since there are two locations in Higashi-Mikuni, there wasn't a long line" and "The staff was attentive and energetic" (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Garlic tonkotsu ramen; kimchi chashu ramen; tsukemen.

anecdotes.text: "The tonkotsu broth was light yet flavorful, packed with umami, and the garlic really hit hard!" — October 2026, shoyu tonkotsu set with garlic.
"I've been captivated by the rich dipping sauce of the Tsukemen for about 10 years now, and it's still amazing." — November 2025.
"I opted for no garlic, and it was a punchy soy sauce tonkotsu ramen." — April 2026, with a mini curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: にんにくラーメン 幸ちゃん 東三国店 (ニンニクラーメン コウチャン ヒガシミクニテン)、大阪市淀川区東三国1丁目33-8、日・月・水・木11:00〜24:00、金・土11:00〜26:00、火曜休み、長時間煮込んだあっさりとコクのあるとんこつスープと自慢のちぢれ麺、みそや赤みそなど、ラーメン以外のサイドメニューやコース、自家製焼ブタ、系列店。食べログ (店舗会員): 東三国1-33-9、東三国駅南側の歩道橋から5秒、28席、禁煙、2011年9月13日オープン、Kujo ねぎラーメン900円、赤みそラーメン800円。口コミ(2024年6月〜2026年10月): にんにくは希望で、醤油とんこつ、あっさりなのにうまみ、キムチチャーシューメン、つけ麺の濃く少し塩辛いつけだれ、赤みそわかめラーメン1,200円、Kujo ねぎラーメン1,180円、チャーシューメン1,500円、特製みそチャーシューメン1,550円、牛白湯ラーメン、ミニチャーシュー丼350円、焼きチャーシュー丼、ミニカレー500円、チャーハンセット400円、本店に30年通う人も、PayPay 可、深夜の締めに。

osaka_khazana_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Lunch sets come with naan (plain, garlic, onion, sesame, cheese) and rice; biryani and the Gujarati thali are rice-based, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_khazana_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", there is a vegetable curry at lunch, and the Gujarati thali was a vegetarian meal of bean curry, stewed beans and potato subji (May 2026), but dairy (butter chicken, lassi, cheese naan) is common and nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_khazana_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). JCB cards only; PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY (Tabelog). 30 seats; whole hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed per Tabelog, though an April 2026 diner called it non-smoking. Live music (Tabelog); belly-dance evenings (December 2025). Lunch delivery by bicycle north-west of Shin-Osaka Stn (April 2026).
osaka_khazana_nishinakajima.notes: [Indian · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a long-running Indian house with Gujarati food] A 30-seat Indian restaurant on a side street near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, around 25 to 30 years old by its regulars' counts (2024–2025), decorated with embroidery the owner made (May 2026) and full of incense and Indian music. Lunch is cheap and generous: two curries, chicken tikka, saffron rice and a thin, crisp naan with lassi for ¥1,100, or one curry from ¥880. What sets it apart is Gujarati food from West India, rare in Kansai: a vegetarian thali of beans and potato subji, and a lamb biryani. Indian families eat here too (April 2026). Evenings bring live music and sometimes belly dance. JCB is the only card.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who made the embroidery on the walls (May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (khazana-osaka.jp, read 2026-11-02): 本格インド料理カジャナ, a long-established Indian curry restaurant in Nishinakajima-Minamigata. Per the Tabelog listing: Indian, vegetarian options, live music. Per reviews: celebrating its 25th anniversary (October 2024); "Authentic Indian Restaurant Established in Osaka for 30 Years" and "I chatted quite a bit with the owner, who mentioned that [the owner] plans to return to India in a few years" (February 2025); "Homemade dishes from Gujarat in Western India are quite rare in Kansai" (September 2025); "The interior is beautifully decorated with embroidery and other crafts made by the owner" (May 2026); "The clientele consisted of local office workers and Indian families" (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Gujarati thali; Indian lunch sets with thin naan.

anecdotes.text: "I wanted to fully enjoy authentic vegetarian West Indian cuisine just once, so I held back my craving for meat and ordered the Thali lunch." — May 2026.
"The naan was generally thin, with some parts being crispy." — April 2026, KHAZANA lunch with two curries ¥980.
"I learned that [the restaurant is] celebrating [its] 25th anniversary." — October 2024.

osaka_wafu_motsu_ryori_arata_nishinakaji.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Offal stews in a Japanese broth, demi-glace tongue and tail stews, soy-glazed grilled lung and skewers; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_wafu_motsu_ryori_arata_nishinakaji.hours_raw: 17:00–21:30, closed Monday, Sunday and holidays, with special closures at New Year; the shop asks you to check its X account for changes (shop site, read 2026-11-02). Tabelog gives Tue–Sat 17:00–20:00. No reservations (shop site; Tabelog): queue at the door, from before 16:00 for the first seating (August 2026). Two seatings of about two hours, 12 people each, with a full turnover (August 2026; December 2025). Cash only; no service charge (Tabelog). 12 counter seats (two spare chairs); non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_wafu_motsu_ryori_arata_nishinakaji.notes: [Offal · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the beef-offal counter people queue for] A 12-seat basement counter three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, winner of The Tabelog Award Bronze in 2025 and 2026, where there are no bookings and the line starts before 16:00 for a 17:00 opening. Take the omakase: about nine dishes of spotless beef offal in order, from a mild Japanese-style motsu stew and spleen sashimi through tongue and tail stews in a gentle demi-glace, blanched mino, smoked neck, raw senmai with sesame sauce and heart sashimi, to a tail soup or zosui. The owner explains each dish (August 2026). With a beer and a few of the house ¥300 highballs it comes to about ¥5,000–6,300 (2024–2026). Two seatings a night, cash only; check the shop's X account before going.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who explains each dish (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (wafumotsu.com, read 2026-11-02): 和風もつ料理 あらた, "スキー大好き人間の集まるお店" (a shop where ski lovers gather); no reservations; 17:00–21:30; closed Monday, Sunday and holidays; updates on X (@Arata_ShinOsaka). Per the Tabelog listing: The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze; 12 counter seats; cash only. Per reviews: "The owner and staff quickly serve up various motsu dishes" in a counter-only room like a Showa-era izakaya (January 2020); "The owner explained the dishes as they were served, creating a warm and pleasant atmosphere" (August 2026); the seating changed to full turnovers (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef-offal omakase; Japanese-style motsu stew.

anecdotes.text: "On a weekday, I arrived at 3:40 PM, aiming for the first seating. Since I was at the front of the line, I sat down and waited for the opening." — August 2026, omakase of 9 dishes.
"These aren't your typical whiskey highballs; they have a unique flavor and an impressive surface tension." — December 2025.
"The raw Omasum with sesame sauce was outstanding; personally, I found the stew and this dish to be the top two highlights." — August 2026.

osaka_sushi_tatsuki_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The course includes tempura (hamo and lotus root) and ends with a ramen of wheat noodles; nigiri are usually seasoned with soy sauce, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_sushi_tatsuki_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase ending with a ramen in a fish-bone broth.
osaka_sushi_tatsuki_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00 in two sittings, 17:30–19:30 and 20:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Online booking only, no phone bookings; a party of eight takes the whole counter (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_tatsuki_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, ¥4,400 entertainment omakase] An eight-seat sushi counter on the third floor of a Kitashinchi building that sets out to make counter sushi unintimidating. The evening starts with the lights down and a video of the chef's life on a big screen (a kendo background is part of the story), then runs through about fifteen dishes for ¥4,400: Tosa-vinegar scallops, bonito, hamo tempura, charcoal-dusted squid, aged tuna, an upside-down inari from the chef's grandmother's recipe, and a fish-bone ramen that several diners rate above most ramen shops. Two sittings a night, 17:30 and 20:00, booked online only. Diners describe a cheerful owner who chats with everyone; two people spent about ¥11,000 with drinks (October 2026). A sister of a Shinsaibashi sushi shop, per one review.

chef_bio.origin: Sister restaurant of a sushi shop in Shinsaibashi (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): friendly, authentic counter sushi in Kitashinchi, each piece made in the spirit of "ippon shobu" from kendo; an omakase of the day's freshest ingredients, aged tuna and the "gyaku-sainari" the chef's grandmother used to make; "Entertainment Sushi". A September 2026 diner describes the opening video of the chef's life; an October 2026 diner notes the head chef's kendo background. The Tabelog name field reads "Sushi Tatsuki", while its shop text calls it "Sushi Ryurai".
chef_bio.philosophy: Counter sushi that is approachable, memorable and entertaining (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Gyaku-sainari; fish-bone ramen; ¥4,400 omakase.

anecdotes.text: "The lights in the restaurant went out... In the darkness... What appeared on the large TV was... A memoir... from childhood to adulthood..." — September 2026.
"It seems like it was seasoned only with salt and sugar, but honestly, it could compete with any ramen shop!" — October 2026, the ramen finish; ¥11,000 for two.
"On top of the sweet and tender squid, there was even bamboo charcoal!" — September 2026, the ¥4,400 course.

cultural_comfort.note: One set course at an eight-seat counter, booked online; the chef talks with every guest (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_matsui.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include tempura (fig, September–October 2026) and dishes with soy and liver sauces; soy sauce for sashimi is self-serve at the counter (September 2026) and normally contains wheat.
osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_matsui.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Edomae sushi omakase with abalone, soft-shelled turtle and shark fin.
osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_matsui.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the day before a holiday 18:00–23:00, in two sittings starting at 18:00 or 20:30; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). The ¥11,000 nigiri course is for the 20:30 sitting only (Tabelog). Dress code: no shorts, flip-flops or tank tops (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (Tabelog); a review also mentions table seats and private rooms (October 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 24 April 2026 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_matsui.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, Edomae from a Kyubey-trained chef] A basement sushi counter in Kitashinchi, opened in April 2026, where a chef trained at Ginza Kyubey serves Edomae sushi on red-vinegar rice. The ¥16,500 course runs to twenty dishes: grilled tuna cheek and brain to start, hamo jelly or seasonal simmered dishes, abalone with liver sauce, a turtle-and-shark-fin dobin-mushi, and eleven nigiri; a nigiri-only course is ¥11,000 at the late sitting. Most diners found it good value for Kitashinchi. One September 2026 diner was less happy: the same piece was made for every guest at once, sashimi soy sauce was self-serve, and staff let neighbours play videos aloud. Part of a group that also runs Gyoza no Kacchan, per that review. Dress smartly; two sittings, 18:00 and 20:30.

chef_bio.origin: Part of a restaurant group that also operates Gyoza no Kacchan (September 2026 review); "part of a group that operates several dining establishments" (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): "A chef trained at Ginza Kyubey" brings Edomae technique to Kitashinchi; red-vinegar rice; ageing, salting, vinegar curing and kombu curing; simmered, grilled and steamed dishes tailored to each ingredient. Opened 24 April 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Edomae technique with a playful spirit (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae omakase on red-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: "However, it seems they prepare the same type of sushi for each guest and serve it all at once, possibly to keep the flow going." — September 2026.
"We started with the cheek and brain meat of bluefin tuna! The rich umami and sweetness of the fat were exhilarating right from the start." — October 2026, the 20-dish course.
"The rice was so tasty that I wanted to have more sushi!" — October 2026.

osaka_chinese_sangu_sky_building.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include dim sum, soup dumplings, noodles in thick sauce, Peking duck with sweet miso, black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork and dishes in seafood soy sauce and XO sauce, which usually contain wheat.
osaka_chinese_sangu_sky_building.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese courses of shark fin, seafood, duck, pork and wagyu, with chicken stocks.
osaka_chinese_sangu_sky_building.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (last order food 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order food 21:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30 (last order food 14:30) and 17:00–22:00; closing days not fixed; hours may change, so phone ahead (Tabelog). Cancellation: 20% from two days before, 50% from the day before, 100% on the day (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, au PAY (Tabelog). 120 seats: 60 on the dining floor and four private rooms for 2–60; children's meals available (Tabelog; October 2026). Parking in Umeda Sky Building B2F, ¥500 the first hour, with free time for diners (Tabelog).
osaka_chinese_sangu_sky_building.notes: [Chinese · Umeda Sky Building, 39th floor] The Chinese restaurant on the 39th floor of the Umeda Sky Building, with views over Osaka by day and a night view diners call outstanding. Courses use Cantonese technique: mango-mayonnaise prawns are the signature, alongside Peking duck, shark fin from Kesennuma, steamed amadai and braised wagyu cheek. Lunch courses (¥4,000–7,000) are the usual way in; dinners from ¥8,000, plus 10% service. Families and business lunches fill the four private rooms; book a window table or window room for the view, and mention celebrations for a message plate. Service gets mixed notes: kind staff who took family photos (October 2026), but missed orders and slow responses in a private room (September 2026) and slow drinks on a fireworks night (October 2026).

osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_ikken.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include fried dishes (in the hassun, August 2026) and nigiri usually finished with soy sauce, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_ikken.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish, shellfish and roe.
osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_ikken.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 17:30–23:00; Thu–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00; last order 22:30; closed Sundays and holidays; may close early when supplies run out (Tabelog). The phone may go unanswered during service (Tabelog). Guests with strong fragrances may be refused (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; private hire by arrangement; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 21 June 2023 (Tabelog). The entrance is round the side of the building, not on the front (October 2026).
osaka_kitashinchi_sushi_ikken.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, a ten-seat counter with two kinds of rice] A ten-seat sushi counter entered from a side street in Kitashinchi, with fish, rice, nori and wasabi chosen from across Japan and nigiri served on two kinds of shari, red-vinegar and white-vinegar, to compare. The dinner omakase runs to over twenty dishes at ¥22,000 (diners booking through an online site paid ¥13,200–13,600 in 2026); lunch, Thursday to Saturday, starts at ¥5,500 for a hassun platter and nigiri. Diners praise a head chef who explains every dish (one review says the chef came from the Ritz-Carlton) and staff who adjust rice portions and mind your departure time; celebrations get a bouquet. One June 2026 diner found the tuna sashimi and sea urchin a little fishy. No strong perfume.

roles: Head chef (unnamed; "from the Ritz-Carlton", per an October 2026 review)

chef_bio.philosophy: Commitment to sourcing, preparation and cooking (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase with red- and white-vinegar shari.

osaka_rasa_hala_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The plates are basmati rice with curries, dal and side dishes, and the biryani is rice-based, but nothing is described as gluten-free and the curry bases are not described.
osaka_rasa_hala_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Ask. A Veggie Plate is on the menu, not spicy (August 2026), and the Ceylon plates include a lentil curry and a vegetable curry (October 2026), but nothing is labelled vegan and the sides are not described.
osaka_rasa_hala_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; Sun 11:00–14:00; closed Monday (Tabelog, hours changed from July 2026). Special events on Poya (full-moon) days; daily specials and days off posted on the shop's Facebook page (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats: two tables for four, three for two, four at the counter; hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Spice adjusted on request, and a children's curry made with notice (Tabelog). Opened 5 December 2011 (Tabelog).
osaka_rasa_hala_higashimikuni.notes: [Sri Lankan · Higashimikuni, rice and curry by the station] A small Sri Lankan restaurant two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, open since 2011 and on Tabelog's Curry WEST 100 in 2019, where a Sri Lankan chef cooks (September 2026). The lunch to order is the Ceylon plate: basmati rice with a meat curry (chicken, pork, mutton or keema), a lentil and a vegetable curry, an egg and five small sides, ¥1,500 for the special (2026), which you mix together as you go. The meat curries can be fierce, the dal gentle; there is a mild Veggie Plate, and biryani with chicken or bone-in mutton. Kal Dothul, a sweet set like a rice cake, finishes it (November 2026). The chef is friendly; ask about heat when ordering. Closed Monday; Sunday lunch only.

chef_bio.origin: Sri Lanka, per a September 2026 review ("The Sri Lankan chef truly delivers authentic flavors").
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: opened 5 December 2011; Tabelog Curry WEST 100 2019; daily specials and days off on Facebook; spice adjusted on request and a children's curry with notice; special events on Poya (full-moon) days. osaka_aruru_higashimikuni.notes: [Bakery café · Higashimikuni, levain bread by day, wine by night] A small bakery and coffee bar a few minutes from Higashimikuni Station, open since 2022 behind a plant-covered front, baking levain breads that reviewers rate highly: a 90%-hydration pain de Lodève of just water and wheat for ¥250, a cheese and dried-fruit loaf, baguettes, an almond croissant and a salt bread one diner loved (2026). Eat in with freshly roasted coffee (one drink each) and warm your bread in the toaster. In the evening it doubles as a bar, with a few wines by the glass and a ¥500 snack set of soup, bruschetta and all-you-can-eat bread with salt and sunflower oil (July 2026). One April 2026 diner found the service curt and the coffee lukewarm. Cash only; open from 7:30, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 4 August 2022 (Tabelog). osaka_udon_kobo_tenku_higashimikuni.notes: [Udon · Higashimikuni, nama shoyu udon from the Hagakure line] A bright udon shop west of Higashimikuni Station, opened in 2019 by a disciple of Osaka's famous Umeda Hagakure (September 2026 reviews), with a counter and a tatami room for families. The house dish is Hagakure's Nama Shoyu Udon: cold, long, firm homemade noodles with grated daikon and green onion, finished at the table when the owner squeezes sudachi and pours a little soy over them, "udon is like sashimi", as the shop puts it (Tabelog). Bukkake, curry and seasonal udon fill the menu; add three fresh tempura for ¥300, or kayaku rice as well for ¥450, and the rice may steal the show (September 2026). It is full by noon; come early. Lunch daily except Sunday, evenings Monday, Wednesday and Thursday only.

roles: Owner (unnamed) trained at Umeda Hagakure, and staff

Reviewers: "run by one of its disciples" (September 2026); a September 2026 diner read on the shop's website that the owner trained at Hagakure in Umeda.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Udon is like sashimi" (Tabelog, the predecessor's teaching).
chef_bio.specialty: Nama Shoyu Udon; kayaku rice.

osaka_chuka_dining_ryusho_nishimiyahara.notes: [Chinese · Nishimiyahara, set lunches with bottomless rice] A neighbourhood Chinese restaurant in the same apartment building as Ramen Yamafuji, west of Shin-Osaka, which per one May 2026 diner began as a tsukemen shop and has grown into a fuller Chinese menu with many staff "from the region". Lunch is the draw: a ¥930–1,100 set (kara-age, shrimp mayo, yodare chicken, a daily special) with egg soup, pickles, a small dessert and rice you refill yourself from a jar in the middle of the room (2026), or a sesame tantanmen or mapo mazesoba. It gets a lunch line and the popular egg fried rice set sells out (August 2026). In the evening it turns into a drinking spot with a two-dish set for ¥1,380 or all-you-can-eat-and-drink for ¥3,880 (2026). Closed Sunday.

osaka_at_the_21_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the batter is made with fine cake flour (official site, Toyonaka shop), and yakisoba, modern-yaki and omusoba carry noodles.
osaka_at_the_21_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the batter uses a house dashi from chicken bones, kombu and other ingredients (official site, Toyonaka shop); fillings are pork, squid, octopus, shrimp, scallop, beef tendon and mochi with cheese, and dishes come with mayonnaise and bonito flakes (Tabelog menu; reviews).
osaka_at_the_21_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; closing days not fixed (closed 21 and 28 November 2026) (Tabelog). Reservations taken; online booking via Tabelog. Cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay; no e-money. 28 table seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (September and October 2026 reviews).
osaka_at_the_21_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba Sennichimae, iron-plate okonomiyaki without a table grill] The Namba branch, opened June 2023, of AT THE 21, an okonomiyaki house opened in 1984 in a smart Toyonaka residential area by the second son of a liquor-shop family. The founding idea, kept here, is a bright café-like room with no grill on the tables: okonomiyaki are cooked in the kitchen and served on a small one-person iron plate, so clothes and hair do not pick up the smell. Diners in 2026 praise the fluffy, thick okonomiyaki and modern-yaki and the big portions; two September and October 2026 diners found the batter dry or the sauce light and did not plan to return. Orders are by QR code. Two diners (September and November 2026) noticed many guests from abroad, and the November diner found the staff attentive and kind.

roles: Shop staff unnamed; Namba branch of AT THE 21 (official site; Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (株式会社２４, representative director 西 真澄), the founder, second son of a liquor shop, opened AT THE 21 in Toyonaka in 1984, choosing okonomiyaki as the dish closest to Osaka people; the glass-fronted, café-like shop with no noren or sign became the talk of the area, and from 2016 the house also had a shop in Panasonic Stadium Suita. The Tabelog listing for Namba (opened 2023-06-01) says the house is "recognized as one of the top 100 establishments".
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bright and modern so that solo diners and women can come in easily"; no iron plates on the tables "so that guests' smart clothes do not pick up stains or smell" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Okonomiyaki and modern-yaki on one-person iron plates.

anecdotes.text: "Since there’s no teppan right in front of you, it’s not hot, and your clothes and hair won’t pick up any odors." — September 2026.
"It was fluffy and served on the teppan, so it stayed hot until the very end—delicious!" — September 2026, mochi-cheese modern-yaki.
"The batter was dry and crumbly, like a custard with chopped green onions thrown in." — September 2026, third visit.
"The food was not particularly memorable, but the service from the staff was very attentive and kind." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (株式会社２４、代表取締役 西 真澄): 酒屋の次男だった創業者が1984年に豊中市でAT THE 21を開店、大阪人に身近なお好み焼き、カフェのようなガラス張りで暖簾・看板なし、お一人様や女性も入りやすい明るくモダンな店、テーブルに鉄板を置かず焼き上がりをオーダーメイドの小さな1人用の鉄板で出す、2016年からパナソニックスタジアム吹田にも出店、生地は鶏ガラ・昆布などの自家製だしとケーキ用の上質な小麦粉、キャベツや青ねぎは季節ごとに一番美味しい産地のもの (豊中の店の説明)。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 難波千日前4-5、2023年6月1日オープン、月〜金12:00〜15:30・17:30〜22:00、土日祝12:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA、Master)・PayPay、テーブル28席、禁煙、子ども歓迎。メニュー (2023年更新): お好み焼き、チーズお好み焼き、焼きそば、ネギ焼き (しょうゆ味)、モダン焼き、チーズモダン焼き、オムそば、マヨネーズとからしは抜きもできる。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月): ふわふわで分厚い、量が多い、QRコードで注文、モダン焼き (ブタ) 1,700円、海鮮のネギ焼き2,100円、外国からの客が多い、生地がぱさつく・ソースが薄いという声も。

osaka_kitashinchi_harami_hozenji.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The harami steak comes with several dips (sauce, egg yolk, truffle, red-wine salt, wasabi, salt), and the menu also has seared nigiri, kalbi, cold noodles and namul (Tabelog menu; reviews); nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_kitashinchi_harami_hozenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a black-wagyu yakiniku restaurant; namul, kimchi and salad are sides and are not described.
osaka_kitashinchi_harami_hozenji.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–23:30 (last food order 23:00); closing days not fixed, posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Courses and seats limited to 2 hours; a no-show is assumed after 15 minutes late without a call (Tabelog). 10% service charge on tax-inclusive prices (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay, d Barai, au PAY; no e-money. 24 seats (8 counter, 16 table); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_harami_hozenji.notes: [Yakiniku · Hozenji Yokocho, black-wagyu harami grilled at the table] The Hozenji Yokocho shop, opened September 2018, of Kitashinchi Harami, a four-shop yakiniku name devoted to harami (outside skirt) of top black wagyu; Tabelog says it was produced by Ryuka Hattori, who trained at the Italian restaurant Ponte Vecchio. Behind a heavy wooden door on the stone-paved alley, staff grill the thick harami steak at the table, flambé it with brandy and slice it in the kitchen; it is eaten with egg yolk, truffle, red-wine salt or sauce. Most 2026 diners take the 13-dish Hozenji course and call it a place for celebrations; one says opinions about the place vary. The house says it was ranked 3rd in Japan in the fine-dining category of TripAdvisor's Best of the Best 2026. A June 2026 diner found all the other guests were from abroad.

roles: Produced by Ryuka Hattori, who trained at the Italian restaurant Ponte Vecchio (Tabelog); grill staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per harami.jp, Kitashinchi Harami runs four shops: the main shop and 北新地別邸 in Kitashinchi, the Hozenji shop and 新大宮店 in Nara (opened May 2020). Per Tabelog, harami is a rare cut of only 2–3 kg per cow, which the house gets through its own channels; the manager visits cattle farms and picks the red meat each week with lean-cut suppliers. The official site says the interiors are by a popular shop designer and the tableware was designed and fired for the house by the fifth-generation potter of やすお陶房 in Shigaraki.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Dishes that women also find easy to eat"; harami that is healthy for the body yet delicious (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu harami steak grilled and flambéed at the table.

anecdotes.text: "The harami steak was served rare, allowing us to enjoy it with sauce and egg yolk." — March 2026, Hozenji course.
"The staff grilled it for us until the end, making for a fun dining experience." — April 2026, at the counter.
"While there are various opinions about this place, I personally found it to be absolutely satisfying!" — May 2026.
"All the other customers were foreigners." — June 2026, ¥9,900 course.
"Highly recommend! Chef Yuji was fantastic. Above and beyond." — Google review shown on the official site.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 北新地はらみ 法善寺店、道頓堀1-7-8 仲谷ビル1F、国産高級黒毛和牛から厳選した部位だけを出すはらみ特化店、ヘルシーで美味しい、「女性も食べやすい料理」、ワインが豊富、人気店舗デザイナーの内外装、食器は信楽焼やすお陶房の五代目安兵工窯が当店のために制作、法善寺横丁にひっそり佇む木造の店、トリップアドバイザー「ベスト・オブ・ザ・ベスト2026」高級店部門日本3位 (2026年10月6日のお知らせ)。グループサイト (harami.jp): 店舗は北新地はらみ本店、北新地別邸、法善寺店、新大宮店 (奈良、2020年5月12日オープン)、名物はらみステーキはスタッフが目の前で焼く。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2018年9月21日オープン、毎日12:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、不定休 (Instagramで告知)、コースは2時間制、サービス料10%、24席、禁煙、Ryuka Hattori (Ponte Vecchio出身) のプロデュース、日本初のはらみ専門、はらみは牛1頭から2〜3kg、店長が牧場を訪ね毎週赤身を厳選、コース9,900円・13,200円・16,500円。口コミ (2026年3月〜8月): 法善寺コース13,200円、はらみステーキをブランデーでフランベし卵黄・トリュフ・赤ワイン塩などで、厚切りタン、肉寿司、スタッフが焼いてくれる、他の客は全員外国人だった (6月)、評価はいろいろだが満足という声。

cultural_comfort.note: A June 2026 diner found all the other guests were from abroad, and the official site shows Google reviews in English, Dutch and French; one Dutch reviewer says the staff prepare the meat and explain how best to eat it. No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

existence.note: Official site with an October 2026 notice and shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

osaka_il_sole_rosso_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Neapolitan pizzeria whose pizza dough uses pizza flour from Italy (official site) and whose menu is mostly pizza and pasta (Tabelog menu). Meat and seafood dishes such as octopus carpaccio exist, but nothing is stated about wheat or the wood-fired oven.
osaka_il_sole_rosso_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. The marinara (tomato sauce, garlic, oregano) carries no cheese (Tabelog menu); nothing is said about the dough.
osaka_il_sole_rosso_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last food order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday, open when Monday is a holiday and then closed Tuesday; also 2–4 irregular days off a month (Tabelog). Reservations taken; a late arrival is treated as a cancellation (Tabelog); an October 2026 diner found a queue at opening on a Saturday and advises booking at weekends. No service charge. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay. 54 seats incl. a 6-seat counter facing the wood-fired oven; elevator, wheelchair accessible; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site).
osaka_il_sole_rosso_shinsaibashi.notes: [Italian · Shinsaibashi, wood-fired Neapolitan pizza since 2004] A Neapolitan pizzeria opened in April 2004 on the second floor of a building near Shinsaibashi Daimaru, the older of the two shops of the Il Sole group, founded in 1994. In April 2007 it became the 242nd member worldwide, and the first in Osaka, of the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana. Firewood is stacked by the Naples-built oven and Napoli shirts hang on the walls. Diners in 2026 praise the charred, chewy Margherita, the honey-drizzled four-cheese pizza and the octopus-in-tomato pasta; one lunch regular has come for about fifteen years. Portions are large; one diner found à la carte pasta pricey and lunch the better deal. Tabelog lists a menu in English, Chinese and Korean.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; shop of 株式会社イル・ソーレ (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the group was founded by 中西康之, a Tsuji graduate who trained in Italy from 1990, including at one-Michelin-star restaurants, and set up Il Sole in 1994; 中西 stepped down in October 2022 and stays on as adviser. The second-generation president 谷健太郎 was on the opening staff of Il Sole Rosso in 2004, became a shop manager at 26 (2009), trained in Cetara, Italy (2010), was named Kansai area leader of the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana and qualified as a sommelier (2013), and became president in October 2022; the site names 谷 as group head manager. The group also ran other shops over the years; its current shops are Il Sole Rosso and Il Sole TEN-3 (Tenjinbashi, 2012). The Tabelog menu calls the octopus carpaccio "a dish I learned in Cetara, Southern Italy" without naming the cook.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Authentic Neapolitan pizza by a pizza-association-certified chef: chewy dough full of the fragrance of wheat" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza; octopus carpaccio with colatura.

anecdotes.text: "I've been a regular at this restaurant for about 15 years." — September 2026, Margherita lunch.
"Upon entering, you’ll notice the firewood stacked up and Napoli uniforms displayed, which adds to the charm of its enduring atmosphere." — October 2026.
"The a la carte pasta is a bit pricey, so lunch is a better option if you decide to go." — September 2026.
"After that, we were served pasta and pizza, but the portions were so large that we couldn't finish them." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: イルソーレ・ロッソは2004年に心斎橋でオープン、20年以上ナポリの味、ナポリピッツァ協会認定シェフの本格ナポリピッツァ、イタリアから取り寄せたピッツァ専用の小麦粉、ランチ1,100円〜、薪窯の見えるカウンター6席。会社概要 (株式会社イル・ソーレ、天神橋3-5-16、設立1994年4月): 創業者中西康之 (辻調理師専門学校卒、1990年イタリア研修、1994年創業、2022年10月退社後顧問・相談役)、2代目代表取締役兼統括店長谷健太郎 (イルソーレロッソオープニングスタッフ、2009年26歳で店長、2010年チェターラで研修、2013年真のナポリピッツァ協会関西エリアリーダー・ソムリエ、2022年代表取締役)、沿革に2004年4月ロッソ、2012年7月 TEN-3 (天神橋) など。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2004年4月27日オープン、2007年4月に真のナポリピッツァ協会の世界242番目・大阪初の認定店、ナポリ製の薪窯、火〜日・祝11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、月曜休み (祝日は営業、翌火曜休み)、月2〜4日の不定休、54席、エレベーターあり、多言語メニュー (英語・中国語・韓国語)、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応ありの表示。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): マルゲリータ、はちみつの4種チーズ、タコのトマトソースパスタ、約15年通う常連、量が多い、アラカルトのパスタはやや高め、週末は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists a multilingual menu (English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Korean) with photos and a digital menu. No evidence on English-speaking staff.

existence.note: Official site and shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_kuromon_wadachi_nipponbashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is dumplings, spring rolls, noodles and sauced stir-fries (Tabelog menu); fried rice, steamed chicken and seafood dishes are not described.
osaka_kuromon_wadachi_nipponbashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Chinese tavern built on meat and seafood; no vegan or vegetarian options are described.
osaka_kuromon_wadachi_nipponbashi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Monday, or the next weekday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; official site). Lunch last order 14:30 per Tabelog, 14:45 per the official site; a September 2026 diner says lunch is served until 2 PM. Reservations taken, lunch included (Tabelog; September 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog); the official site says e-money is not accepted at lunch. 38 seats: 6 counter, 20 table, 12 tatami, private rooms for 4–20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Delivery and takeout (Tabelog).
osaka_kuromon_wadachi_nipponbashi.notes: [Chinese · Nipponbashi, house shumai a minute from the station] A basement Chinese tavern a minute from Nippombashi Station, near Kuromon Market, where the owner, trained for many years under a former embassy head chef, cooks seafood-rich Cantonese dishes with fish bought at the market. The hand-wrapped shumai of pork and shrimp with a yuzu-pepper dip is the name dish, and several lunch regulars come back monthly for it; lunch sets of shumai with kara-age and soup draw a line, though bookings are taken. At night it turns into an izakaya with half-size plates and all-you-can-drink courses. Smoking is allowed (Tabelog).

roles: Owner (店主), unnamed, trained for many years under a former embassy head chef (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the owner cooks Cantonese food full of seafood, picks domestic vegetables and goes directly to nearby Kuromon Market for fish, sometimes serving live fish. Tabelog adds Chinese ingredients from Kobe and seafood from Toyosu and Kuromon. The company introduced a scholarship-repayment support scheme for staff from April 2024 (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Every dish made carefully, with no compromise in pursuing the flavour of the ingredients" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-wrapped shrimp and pork shumai with yuzu-pepper sauce.

anecdotes.text: "The shumai is incredibly delicious—possibly the best I've ever had!" — September 2026, sixth visit.
"All sets include Kara-age, and it would be perfect if there were sets without fried items as well." — September 2026.
"There’s usually a long line, but I made a reservation through Tabelog this time, so it was a breeze." — September 2026, lunch.
"The complimentary tsukune (grilled chicken meatball) is quite large, providing a satisfying experience." — October 2026, dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 中華酒場 黒門-轍-（わだち）、日本橋1-18-4 南地ビルB1階、元大使館料理長の下で長年修行を積んだ店主の海鮮たっぷりの広東料理、野菜は国産、魚は黒門市場で直接仕入れ、時には活魚も、名物しゅうまいは国産豚バラ肉・タイ産バナメイ海老・淡路産たまねぎを手作業で包み蒸しあげ、和風ベースのタレに柚子コショウの自家製付けダレ、飲み放題付きコース、宴会25〜35名、11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:45)・17:30〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、月曜休み (祝日は翌平日)、2024年4月から奨学金返還支援制度。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 38席 (カウンター6、テーブル20、座敷12)、個室、喫煙可、デリバリー・テイクアウト、ランチ670円〜約14種、ご飯おかわり無料、しゅうまい3個230円〜 (2024年12月のメニューでは290円)、神戸の中華食材、豊洲と黒門の魚介。口コミ (2023年〜2026年10月): しゅうまいが一番の人気、月に一度通う客、ランチは行列だが食べログで予約可、名物定食1,300円、しゅうまい定食1,180円、日替わり1,100円、夜は半量の皿も、サービスの Tsukune。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site links a course menu PDF labelled 中国語・English (not opened). No English-speaking staff found in the sources.

osaka_bilancia_umeda_nu_chayamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the lunch is built around an all-you-can-eat bread buffet and the dinner buffet around pizza and pasta; grilled chicken, pork, sea bream and steak mains exist, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_bilancia_umeda_nu_chayamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegetarian options", but no vegetarian or vegan dish is named; the breads, pastas and buffet dishes are not described.
osaka_bilancia_umeda_nu_chayamachi.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sundays and holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); follows NU Chayamachi's hours (Tabelog). Lunch tables 90 minutes when busy; dinner buffet two hours, last order 30 minutes before the end; no split bills (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day bookings may not be possible (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 115 seats, 60 of them on a terrace used in fine weather; a private room for 5–8; non-smoking (Tabelog). Renewed 10 August 2026 (Tabelog; September 2026).
osaka_bilancia_umeda_nu_chayamachi.notes: [Italian · Chayamachi, an all-you-can-eat bread lunch] A large Italian restaurant on the eighth floor of NU Chayamachi, with a fine-weather terrace, that turned in August 2026 to all-you-can-eat. At lunch you choose a main (pasta, chicken, sea bream or steak) and help yourself to a buffet of breads from bakeries around Japan, soup and a drink bar for about ¥1,800; diners in 2026 went back for the sweet-potato croissant, corn bread and a squid-ink mentaiko baguette, warmed in the toasters. At night ¥3,500 buys two hours of 45 dishes, pizza from the wood-fired oven, pasta, prosciutto and caprese, with drinks extra. One September 2026 diner found the breads dry and the pasta choice narrow; others praise the value. No split bills.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an all-you-can-eat bread lunch "featuring famous breads from popular bakeries across the country", authentic Italian all-you-can-eat dinners from ¥3,500, homemade-dough wood-fired pizza, renewed 10 August 2026. The Tabelog invoice number T3120001203504 is registered to 株式会社コズミックダイナー, Nozaki-cho (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).
chef_bio.specialty: Bread-buffet lunch; wood-fired pizza.

anecdotes.text: "…an all-you-can-eat experience featuring 45 dishes, including pizzas, pastas, and appetizers." — September 2026, after the August renewal.
"I couldn't wait and just dove in, probably eating around 15 pieces." — September 2026, the weekday pasta lunch for JPY 1,800.
"The bread was dry and tasted like frozen bread" — September 2026, a lunch with a friend from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ビランチャ 梅田店、イタリアン・パスタ・ビアガーデン、大阪市北区茶屋町10-12 NU茶屋町 8F、阪急茶屋町口のすぐそば、月〜木・日・祝11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、金・土・祝前日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、NU茶屋町に準じる、予約可、別会計不可、ランチは混雑時90分、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、115席 (晴れの日のテラス60席)、8名の個室、禁煙、全国の人気ベーカリーのパンの食べ放題ランチ (1,800円から)、45品の2時間食べ放題 (チキン3,500円、チキンとポーク4,000円)、飲み放題1,000円、プレミアムワイン1,500円、クラフトビール1,800円、自家製生地の窯焼きピッツァ、2026年8月10日にリニューアル。インボイス登録は株式会社コズミックダイナー (野崎町)。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): メインを選ぶパンの食べ放題とスープとドリンクバー、明太クリームのパスタ、ごぼうとベーコンのアラビアータ、グリルチキン、鯛のポワレ、牛ステーキ、さつまいものクロワッサン、とうもろこしのパン、チョコクロワッサン、イカスミ明太のバゲット、フレンチトースト、トースター、45品の食べ放題、生ハム、カプレーゼ、魚介のマリネ、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、から揚げ、スマホで注文、パンがかたく冷凍のようだという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Buffet lunch with a main chosen from a short list; smartphone ordering at dinner (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing, renewed August 2026; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_kitashinchi_tsukishiro.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sukiyaki and niku-dofu in sweet soy-based sauces at lunch; the dinner courses add a yukhoe with French bread, dashi-simmered dishes and wagyu hand-rolled sushi.
osaka_kitashinchi_tsukishiro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: black-wagyu dishes with dashi, sake-lees soup and egg.
osaka_kitashinchi_tsukishiro.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–13:50 (last order 13:20), no reservations; dinner Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00 by reservation; Saturday dinner 18:00–22:00 per a September 2026 diner (Tabelog lists Saturday without hours); closed Sundays and holidays except for private bookings; earlier or later times by arrangement (Tabelog). Lunch fills by 11:45; arrive before 11:30 (September–October 2026). No service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 14 seats: a counter of 6 and two tables of 4; non-smoking, ashtray by the lift (Tabelog). Opened 15 June 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_tsukishiro.notes: [Wagyu · Kitashinchi, meat kaiseki by night, sukiyaki by day] A 14-seat black-wagyu restaurant on a third floor in Kitashinchi, open since 2021. In the evening it serves meat kaiseki: truffle-scented yukhoe, beef tongue cut thin and thick, a strip-loin niku-dofu in dashi, chateaubriand over Kishu binchotan and wagyu hand-rolled sushi, from ¥11,000. Weekday lunch is the famous bargain: a ¥1,500 sukiyaki set of black-wagyu chuck rib with an onsen egg, glossy freshly cooked rice, cold tofu with whitebait and a hearty sake-lees soup, or a niku-dofu or dashimaki set. Lunch takes no bookings and the counter is full within fifteen minutes of opening, so come before 11:30; one regular has been eleven times (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a meat kaiseki restaurant showcasing black-haired wagyu through various methods, with chateaubriand grilled over Kishu binchotan; freshly cooked rice at lunch; opened 15 June 2021. The official site is kitashinchi-tsukishiro.com.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The best dish for today's moment" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu meat kaiseki; sukiyaki lunch set.

anecdotes.text: "We arrived at 11:10 AM and there were no customers waiting yet, but soon after, a line began to form, and by the time the restaurant opened at 11:30, it was nearly full." — September 2026, the sukiyaki set meal.
"My colleague's first comment was, 'The rice looks incredibly shiny and beautiful!'" — September 2026, a sixth visit.
"There's no other restaurant in Shinchi that offers such high-quality lunch on weekdays." — September 2026, a fourth visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 つきしろ、牛肉料理・焼肉・ステーキ、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-9-12 フォーシーズンフロント 3F、北新地駅から徒歩5分、月〜金11:30〜13:50 (L.O.13:20、予約不可)、18:00〜22:00 (予約可)、日・祝は貸切のみ、早い時間や遅い時間は相談、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、14席 (カウンター6、4名のテーブル2)、禁煙 (エレベーター前に灰皿)、2021年6月15日オープン、黒毛和牛をいろいろな調理法で、紀州備長炭で焼くシャトーブリアン、ランチは炊きたてのごはん、コース Oborozuki 5品11,000円、YOITUKI 13,200円 (トリュフ香る和牛ユッケ、薄切りと厚切りの牛タン、ロースの肉豆腐、シャトーブリアン、和牛の手巻き寿司、デザート)、Kasumizuki 16,500円。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年10月): すき焼き定食1,500円 (黒毛和牛の肩ロース、温泉卵、ごはん、しらすの冷奴、粕汁)、肉豆腐定食1,500円、肉のせだし巻き定食、ごはん大盛り100円、麹のおかゆ、ウニとキャビアのユッケとフランスパン、11時半前に行列、11時45分には満席、入口がわかりにくい、11回通う常連。

osaka_tora_toriya_ohatsutenjin.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakitori with salt or sauce, chicken nanban with tartar, gratin, motsunabe, kamameshi and oyakodon; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_tora_toriya_ohatsutenjin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Miyazaki-chicken restaurant; seasonal salads and grilled corn sit beside chicken dishes.
osaka_tora_toriya_ohatsutenjin.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 16:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner came for a lunch set, which the listing does not mention. Reservations accepted; 90-minute limit at busy times; a booking is cancelled 15 minutes late without notice; overbooked guests may be sent to a related shop; groups of six or more courses only; course fee charged in full from 23:00 the day before, seat-only bookings ¥3,000 a head (Tabelog). Starter charge ¥420 plus tax; 10% extra over the New Year (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 60 seats: a counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs, private rooms for 2 to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 16 October 2020 (Tabelog).
osaka_tora_toriya_ohatsutenjin.notes: [Yakitori · Ohatsu Tenjin, Miyazaki chicken over binchotan] A busy, two-storey yakitori izakaya by the Ohatsu Tenjin shrine, opened in 2020, that grills Miyazaki free-range chicken over binchotan and uses the whole bird, with a few rare Jidokko a day. Order skewers one at a time, with chicken and liver sashimi, a tsukune under grilled cheese and corn glazed in sauce, then a kamameshi that is worth ordering early. Groups book the two-hour drink courses from ¥4,500, some with a Hakata motsunabe. The ground-floor counter is cramped and smoky and the upper floor roomier (October 2026), and one August 2026 diner found the noise from a neighbouring group hard to bear. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the owner prepares by hand, every day, chicken chosen out of love for it; Miyazaki free-range chicken and Jidokko, a breed said to be 1% of chicken eaten in Japan, the whole bird used; private rooms; opened 16 October 2020. The Tabelog invoice number T2120001214766 is registered to 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (NTA invoice register), also the operator of 梅田かに食堂 (osaka_umeda_kani_shokudo).
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori; chicken sashimi; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: "You can order yakitori one skewer at a time, and the quality was great, including rare chicken liver sashimi, which made me very happy." — August 2026.
"The kamameshi (rice cooked in a pot) takes some time to prepare, so it might be a good idea to order it first." — October 2026.
"The first floor has only a counter and feels a bit cramped, but the second floor has table seating and is relatively spacious. I recommend the second floor." — October 2026.

osaka_tsunemasa_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Natural-yam hotpot in a bonito dashi finished with soba, tempura, crab cream croquettes, fried yam, kara-age and soy-based simmered fish; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_tsunemasa_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, meat and bonito-dashi dishes; the natural yam is served in dashi or with seafood.
osaka_tsunemasa_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–4:00 (last order 3:00); Sat 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and holidays and over New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two-hour limit when busy; a seat-only online booking that clashes with a phone booking may be cancelled (Tabelog). 10% charge after 22:00 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats, up to 35 for whole-shop hire; counter of about eight and tables, shoes off at the entrance; smoking allowed (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 4 February 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_tsunemasa_kitashinchi.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, natural-yam hotpot until 4:00] A dim, Kyoto-townhouse-style izakaya on a second floor in Kitashinchi, open since 2013 and until 4:00 on weekdays, where you take off your shoes before sitting at the counter or tables. The kitchen buys fish direct from Numajima port on Awaji and natural yam from farmers, and the signature is a hotpot of shrimp, oysters, clams, pork and fish in bonito dashi under a blanket of grated yam, finished with soba (December 2025). Otherwise order the five-kind sashimi, simmered Awaji fish, obanzai or yam three ways. Courses from ¥6,000; a 10% charge applies after 22:00. Smoking is allowed, which one December 2025 diner minded; diners otherwise praise the food and staff.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh fish delivered directly from Numajima fishing port on Awaji Island, natural yam direct from farmers used in a specialty hotpot, a space like a Kyoto townhouse, local sake from across Japan; sister shops "Kita-Shinchi Ono Meat Shop" (yakiniku and horumon) and "Kita-Shinchi Ushinokami" (premium meat); opened 4 February 2013.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-yam hotpot; Awaji fish.

anecdotes.text: "The hot pot was packed with ingredients like pork, head-on shrimp, oysters, chicken, clams, and sawara, topped with natural yam, making it incredibly tasty." — December 2025, a year-end party.
"Since smoking is allowed, the people at the table next to us were smoking quite a bit, which left a strong smell on my clothes and hair." — December 2025, the ¥6,000 course with drinks.
"…a wide variety of obanzai (traditional side dishes), including nostalgic flavors reminiscent of home-cooked meals from my childhood" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 恒雅、海鮮・日本料理・鍋、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-5-32 ボーネールビル 2F、JR 東西線 北新地駅から徒歩3分、東梅田駅・西梅田駅から5分、月〜金18:00〜翌4:00 (L.O.3:00)、土18:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、日・祝休み、年末年始休み、予約可、混雑時は2時間制、22時以降はチャージ10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、30席 (貸切35名まで)、喫煙可、2013年2月4日オープン、Awaji の Numajima 漁港から直送の鮮魚、農家直送の自然薯の名物鍋、京町家のような空間、全国の地酒、自然薯の鍋のコース6,000円、刺身・おばんざい・天ぷら・煮魚・和牛ローストの6,000円のコース、キンキの焼き物と牛ヒレカツの8,000円のコース、系列店は Kita-Shinchi Ono Meat Shop と Kita-Shinchi Ushinokami。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): 自然薯の鍋 (豚、有頭エビ、カキ、鶏、アサリ、サワラ)、締めのそば、カニクリームコロッケ、自然薯とマグロ、自然薯そうめんと卵黄、自然薯の揚げ物、自然薯の鉄板焼き、おばんざい3種、刺身5種 (赤貝、ヒラメ、カンパチ、ハマチ、マグロ)、Numajima の魚の煮付け、Aomori のキンキの焼き物、Miyazaki の牛カツ、松茸の釜めし、馬肉のユッケ、豚肩ロースの味噌焼き、豚と川エビのせいろ蒸し、kara-age、靴を脱いで上がる、喫煙可で服ににおい、スタッフが親切、遅くまで開いている。
